Kwonde duto, e ru ler duto, Mondo giwinj Injili.
Kendo igoye e gwenge, Kod wang`yore duto te;
Mond` iland wach ni ji duto, Kaka Wuoro luongogi.
Jogo be ma ting` ohewo, Magombo yudo thuolo;
Nyisgi kaka Ruoth Jawarwa, Wacho, "Biuru ira."
chorus: Jarit, go tung` mar Injili, Ka igoye gi teko;
Nyasachi e mosechiki, Jo motwe giyud thuolo.

title: Dhiuru ,Jokristo
stanzas: Dhiuru, JoKristo, landuru e piny, Dhi gi Wach mar Nyasaye ni jo makiya;
Yesu ni Jatendu ka mudwaro dhi;
Puonjuru ji duto, En notho nigi.
Satan ni jasigu moriwu e yo; To unyalo riembe gi teko Yesu;
Kik uluor, JoKristo, dhiuru gi chir;
Kik uluor, chiedhuru,Yesu ni kodu.
Oganda jo Nyasaye mosetelonwa, Wan waluwo bang` gi e wang`yo achiel;
Ok wapogre kodgi; wan gi yie achiel;
Kuom dini gi genruok, wan achiel kodgi.
Weruru, JoKristo, beduru mamor;
Wendeu medo duong` ni Kristo Jawar.
Pak, gi duong`, gi teko, ni Yesu ma Ruoth,
Un gi malaika pake nyaka chieng`.
chorus: Dhiuru Jo Kristo, landuru e piny,
Dhi gi wach mar Nyasaye ni jo makiya.

title: Chunya Mondo Ichiew Koro
stanzas: Chunya, mondo ichiew koro, Tim teko e tichni;
Ked Lweny maber ni Yesu Ruoth, Niyudi osimbo.
En dwond Nyasaye moluongoi, Kowuoyo e chunyi;
Tim kinda nyaka giko, to Noruaki dalane.
Joneno to nitie mang`eny mang`iyoi pile;
Weche mokadho, kiki par, To teg wang`i nyime.
Teko mwakedogo e lweny, Wayudo kuomi,Ruoth
Kamano bende kwaloyo, Locho ni mari, Ruoth.

title: Jo Maler Mag Nyasaye
stanzas: Jo maler mag Nyasaye, e wachne maler Oketonu mise madier mar genruok;
Jogo maringo ir Yesu ma Jawar,
Omiyogi singruok maber moloyo.
"Kik iluor, an kodi, chunyi kik oa; An ma Nyasachi, pod ayie konyoi;
Nategi, nakonyi, mondo itim chir;
Kipadori kuoma, lueta nosiri. Kipadori kuoma, lueta nosiri."
"Kata kikadho e masira malich, Kata kuyo mapek ok noneg chunyi;
Anabed kodi, nagwedhi e chandruok;
Hapa nobed kodi e chandruok malit. Hapa nobed kodi e chandruok malit."
"Ka Satan otemi gi temruok mager, Ng`wonona oromi; namiyi loyo;
Kuom temruok magerno machalo gi mach,
Adwaro pwodhi mond` ibed maler chuth."

title: Chunya, Mond' Iriti
stanzas: Chunya, mond` iritri, Wasigu lworoi;
Gitemo loyoi pile Mondo itim richo.
Ritri galam; kedi, Ni kik ogoyi piny;
Kedi matek ndalo duto, Kikwayo kony Nyasaye.
Locho pod ni nyime, Rit gi lwenji maber;
Tim kinda, Lweny ok enorum Nyaka`iyud osimbo.

title: Ok Ageno Gimoro Ngang'
stanzas: Ok ageno gimoro ngang`,To remb Yesu kod dimbruokne;
Ok dak agen ng`ato moro,
Ayiengora kuom nying Yesu.
Kata mudho umo wang`a,Apadora kuom ng`wonone;
En ok onyalo lokore,
En loch mak nyal pudhore.
Rembe gi misango mare E ma ageno chutho ka;
Gik man e piny kadho duto, Ruoth Jawarna e moroma.
En ka nobi kigoyo bu,Mond` oyuda ka an ng`ate;
Koruaka gi dimbruok mare Nabed maler e nyim kom duong`.
chorus: Kuom Lwanda Yesu achungo,
En kende manyalo geno,
En kende manyalo geno.

title: Chunguru Matek Kuom Ruoth
stanzas: Chunguru matek kuom Ruoth Nyasachwa,
Kuneno chandruok, ka temruok biro;
En e tekowa, bende ngimawa Ka richo dwaro lowa.
Chungi kuom adier kiwuotho e piny, Bed gi chuny maler kod yie motegno;
Kwageno Ruodhwa, wanalo chutho Richo duto manie piny.
Chung` matek, gene, nomiyi loyo;
Enoriti pile e piny marach;
Kristo Ruoth kende mamiyi yueyo Ka chandruok mar piny rumo.
chorus: Wachunguru matek, wachunguru matek,
Kuom Kristo ma Lwandawa;
Ka wadhil e lwenjwa,wanabed gi mor,
Kod jogo molworo kom duong`.

title: Rituru, Lemuru
stanzas: Rituru, lemuru , Kapod kinde nite,
Ndalo odong matin, Nyaka Ruodhwa Nobi;
Ringruok dhano onyap, Jasikwa en otek;
Lemuru kurito biro mar Yesu Ruoth.
Nindo kik mak wang`wa, Chunywa kik go kiawa;
To osesingonwa ngima ma nyaka chieng` ;
Remb Yesu nochwernwa nochandore ni wan;
Watim kinda Koro, Kik othonwa nono.
Genuru Yesu chuth, Enobed tekowa;
Watwe gi lwenjewa, Jasigu ni butwa;
Kinde mapod odong` kik kadhonwa nono,
Nyaka Ruodhwa no bi to warite galam.
chorus: Warit, Walem, Warit, Walem;
Watim kinda nyaka chieng` Ruodhwa biro;
Warit gi lemo.

title: Chungi Jakristo
stanzas: Chungi, jakristo, Ne jasiki cha;
Bedi ka jachir mar Yesu,
Kik iluor Satan kata tekone;
Gen Yesu Kristo Gi wach Nyasaye.
Kaw okumba yie, Gi ogut Konyruok,
Kendo ligangla mar Muya,
Kik iwe lamo ma nitekoni;
Yesu okonyo askeche.
Wuothuru matek kik uol eyo;
Yaluru pile wach Nyasaye.
Un kuti maber, Chieng` kobiro Unubed kode e ngimane.
chorus: A e nindo, Bedi ka jakedo;
Chungi, Kedi Wanalo Satan,
Kik waluore, Yesu ni jatelo Oseloyo lweny gi Tekone.

title: Waged E Lwanda Mangima
stanzas: Wagedi e lwanda mangima,kuom Yesu lwanda mochwere;
En kar Konyruokwa e piny marach, ka yamb temruok okudho.
Moko gedo kuom kuoyo mayom, Gigeno mwandu mar pinyni;
Moko ketore kuom timbe piny, kuom morne to gi gombo.
Wageduru kuom Lwanda matek En mise ma ok nomukre;
En gi migeno ma nyaka chieng`, Genruok mar warruok marwa.
chorus: Waged e Lwanda, (Waged e Lwanda, Lwanda motegno),
Waged e... Lwanda.
Waged e lwanda, Lwanda motegno,
Kristo e Lwandano.

title: Awuotho Kachiko Polo
stanzas: Awuotho kachiko polo, pile amedo chorora;
Akwayo Ruoth ndalo duto, "Ruoth telna e yo mar polo".
Chunya ok mor ka abedo kod kiawa gi luoro bende;
E pinyni ok adwar dakie, Akwayi tera e polo.
Adwaro dak mabor gi piny, ka ma Satan ok ditema;
Kuom yie awinjo dwol mamit, dwond wend jo maler e polo.
Adwaro chopo e polo, Adwaro neno ler polo;
Analem nyaka achopie, "Ruoth telna e yo mar polo."
chorus: Ting`a malo kendo chunga, kuom Yie, e dala me polo;
Kama malo moloyo piny; Ruoth, taya e yo mar polo.

title: Jarito Mar Dala Zayun
stanzas: Jarito mar dala Zayun, Giko piny donge chiegni?
Ineno ranyisi koso Moserieny e wang`yori?
Jawuoth, chungi, ing`i malo, Ler dwaro rienynwa koro;
Ruakri gi law mar kisera, Piny oyawore koro.
Jarito, ne ler kabiro, Med menyo wang`yori;
Ranyisi ni kwonde duto, Manyiso wach birone.
Ka tung` mar polo noyuagi Jo maler ma nosetho
Ginichier e tung` piny duto, Ginyud ngima mak rum.
Bed mamor, ler koro neno Mar ndalo maduong` mar Ruoth;
Wanahul wachni gi teko: Pinyruoth koro chiegni.
Jawuoth, ting` wang`i, ne loka; Duong` mar Kanaan fwenyore,
Gi dala maber mar Nyasaye, -- En Jerusalem Manyien.
E dalano mar dhahabu, Wanane Ruoth mar Zayun Kobedo e kom maduong`ne,
koseruakore gi ler; E pinyruodhno mar Nyasachwa Mudho ok nobedie ngang`;
Gik ma wang`wa pok oneno E ma wanane kuno.
Jarito, piny chiegni koro, Kod olembe mag ngima;
En mana loka machiegni; Nitie puodho mar Eden.
Winji wende ma giwero, Mayiecho yembe polo;
Ne, ji tara; winji wendgi; Wabiro chopo kanyo.

title: In Migeno Chamo Mwandu Me Polo
stanzas: In migeno chamo mwandu me polo, Nang`o inindo kichiegni chopo?
Chiew chunyi koro, twe gi lwenji duto;
Tim kinda, to ndalo kadho piyo.
In migeno chamo mwandu me polo, Nang`o igalri kichiegni donjo?
Chungi iikri, Jawarwa obiro;
Iromne kolor e boche polo.
Timbe mag pinyni kik mond` olomb chunyi;
Duto mag piny kadho kendo rumo;
Chod oko gigo mosetweyo chunyi,
Kigeno chopo kawo gikeni.
Wang`i kik riwni, to mond` ing`i malo,
Kikiyo biro mar Ruodhwa maduong`;
Ndalono chiegni, lerne dwaro neno;
Waikre mar romo kod Ruoth gi mor.

title: Un Jorit Mar Dala Zayun
stanzas: Un jorit mar dala Zayun, Nyiswa wach mar otieno
Ratego oneno koso? Piny dwaro runwa koso?
Ka ung`iyo, dong uneno ler kawuok?
Weche piny donge nyisowa, Wuodhwa ka ogik rumo
Wachiegni gi polo koso? Wang`wa donge omake?
Wanyal geno, ka pinyruoth polo chiegni?
Ler orienynwa, Ruodhwa biro! Onego waland wachno
Ratego koro oneno, Polo ku orieny maler
Wamoruru, warruokwa koro chiegni
Waseyudo jatend wang`yo, Wang`eyo pinyno chiegni
Wadhiuru nyime piyo, Wagik donjo ka mokuwe
Waweruru, ka wajiwogo chunywa

title: Nyaka Karang'o Ruodhwa
stanzas: Nyaka karang`o Ruodhwa, ma pod waritoi?
Chunywa odoko mapek Kuom rito bironi
Chieng`no nobi karang`o Ma piny noyawrenwa,
Mi lerni norieny kuomwa ,-- Lerni ma nyaka chieng`?
Jawar, nibi karang`o, Ni mond` iom jogi?
To wach makuyo chunywa -- Ji nok maritoi
Jotichni josamuoyo, Ji hero weche piny;
Nitie ji manok kende Maritoi gi mor.
Chiew chuny jogi, Nyasachwa, Kendo isiemgi chuth;
Wachni odhi gi teko -- "Jawarwa chiegni"
Walos techewa duto, Kwaikre ni Ruodhwa;
Walos chunywa makare Mar neni wang` gi wang`.

title: Kristo En Jatelowa
stanzas: Kristo En jatelowa e lwenjewa, Ok waluoro dhiyo ka mochikowa;
Kata ok wang`eyo gi man e nyimwa, Wanaluwe yo duto.
Mond` wayal injilikuonde duto te; Eka wanakethi teko mar Satan;
Kristo ma jatendwa oseloyo piny, Wanaluwe yo duto.
Kata lweny otek, wang`eyo wanalo; Eka wanamor kaachiel gi jomaler;
Ka wariwo duondwa e wer mar locho, Kwaluwe nyaka giko.
chorus: Wadhiuru Ruoth ochikowa;
Wadhiuru kedo gi Satan, Wadhiuru nyaka piny manyien,
Wanalo chutho kuom kristo Ruoth.

title: Wakwayi, Ruoth, Kuom Tekoni
stanzas: Wakwayi, Ruoth, kuom tekoni Ma jogi chon nobedogo;
Ma nojiwo chunygi chutho,Nokonyogi dhil e chandruok .
Ere muya ma nomiyo Ibrahim chir kuom chung` matek;
Ma notego chuny Paulo be, Kopong`e gi teko maler.
Miwa tekoni, kaka chon Elija noyudo teko;
Nonenore kuom Musa be, Nojiwo Ayub e temruok.
Par ndalogo machon, Ruodhwa, Chiw teko kendo jiw tichni;
Kendo ka chunywa paroi Mond` iol Rohoni kuomwa.

title: Keduru Jo Ka Yesu
stanzas: Keduru , Jo ka Yesu, Jokedo mag Kristo;
Keluru kuodi magu, Makuru tong` gi luth.
Yesu Jageng`a marwa, Otelonwa maber;
Weuru luoro duto, Keduru ka mager.
Keduru, jo ka Yesu, Wasigu marwa kwiny;
To Yesu En kokonywa Wanyalo loyo en;
Satani ni wasigu Madwaro negowa;
To ka walu bang` Yesu Wabiro hewo en.
Keduru, jo ka Yesu, Ndalo odong` matin;
Tinde wadhi kedo, Kiny wadhi weyo lweny
Mohewo e moyudo E polo gik mathoth;
To nyaka chieng` e polo, Osiko kodi Ruoth.

title: Yaye Mad Abed Gi Yie Chutho
stanzas: Yaye mad abed gi yie chutho,Ma ok dak swekre ngang`,
Kata wasigu lworoa,Kat` ayudo chandruok, Kat` ayudo chandruok.
Yie ma ok dak obed gi ng`ur Kata ayud malit;
Kata e masira malit Ayiengra kuom Nyasaye, Ayiengra kuom Nyasaye.
Yieno mond` oyangre maler Ka yamb temruok kudho;
Kata abedo ka marach Kik abedi maluor, Kik abedi maluor.
Kata ka jopiny obwona,Kata gichaya ngang`,
Weche mag piny kik wuond chunya Mar gola kuomi, Ruoth; Mar gola kuomi Ruoth.
Ruoth, miya yie ma kamano, Yie ma ok lokrengang`;
Kata piny bet koda marach Agen dak kodi, Ruoth; Agen dak kodi Ruoth.

title: Jakristo We Nindo
stanzas: Jakristo we nindo, Ruoth emochiko,
Kaw tong gi okumba kiting`e e lweti;
Mond` irom gi jatem kionge luoro,
Chungi ka jachir, King`iyo jasigu.
Kata e chandruok, winji wach maber bed motang`,
To kik idog chien, kama konyruok onge ,
Oganda mag mudho, inyalo riembo,
Chungi ka jachir, king`iyo jasigu.
Rit tich mar Ruodhi, Gi tekoni duto
Riti gi kinda, Kedi nyaka giko
Kama enotelnie, Dhi ka in jachir,
Chungi ka jachir, king`iyo jasigu.
chorus: Bedi jachir, Bedi jachir,
Bedi jachir, King`iyo jasigu.

title: Be An Jarit Msalaba
stanzas: Be an jarit msalaba, jalup mar Nyarombo?
Ok dak aluor wuoth`e tichne kata luongo nyinge?
Oneg` adhiyo e polo, gi kuwe mogundho chuth,
Ka jomamoko to kedo e dier namno mar tho?
Aneno wasigu `luora, donge dachop kucha,
Pinyni orach onge ng`wono maditera ka Ruoth.
Adier naked mond` ayud loch Ruoth named jiwora,
Ok anadew chwat kata lit kayiengora kuomi.
chorus: Wanageng` temruok nyaka wachopi ire
Wanageng` temruok nyaka wanagow loka.

title: Biuru, Jo Nyasaye
stanzas: Biuru, jo Nyasaye, Mohero En adier;
Weruruwa gi chuny achiel, Weruruwa gi chuny achiel,
Kwachokre nyim Nyasaye,Kwachokre nyim Nyasaye.
Jopiny mokia Nyasaye, Biuru wadende,
To wan nyithinde wanawer,To wan nyithinde wanawer,
Kwapako Ruodh polo,Kwapako Ruodh polo.
Nyithindo mag Nyasaye, Gimor ma nyaka chieng`;
Ka pok gitundo par Nyasaye, Ka pok gitundo par Nyasaye,
Ka pod giwuotho ka Ka pod giwuotho ka.
Kata wayud chandruok E piny ma mwalo ni,
Watego wang`wa kuomi, Ruoth,Watego wang`wa kuomi, Ruoth,
Kwachiko dalani Kwachiko dalani.
chorus: Wadhiyo (e) piny Ruodhwa,
Dala maber mar Nyasachwa;
Wachiko wang`wa ni Zayun (maler)
En dala maber mar Nyasaye.

title: Nitie Lweny Mager Ahinya
stanzas: Nitie lweny mager ahinya, kind adiera gi mudho,
Ka lweny obedo malich ngang`, kwakedo gi jasigu,
Ruoth dwaro joma jochir,Donge doyiengre kuomi.
Ni gibiro gi mirima, ka gin gi teko Satan.
Giyudo teko mar jachien, Moa negi e mudho,
Ruoth dwaro joma jochir,Donge doyiengre kuomi?
Nyasaye wuonwa to nenowa, Malaika konyowa,
Kendo jatendwa en Yesu, ok nwarem, kata podho,
Ruoth dwaro joma jochir,Donge doyiengre kuomi.
chorus: Donge doyiengre kuomi? Onego imiye duong`
Wach gi chir, Muya maler Mondo oyiengre kuomi.

title: Ndalo Auchiel Oserumo
stanzas: Ndalo auchiel oserumo, Sabato ochopo kendo;
Chunya, bedi mamor chutho, Mondo irite kod ng`wono.
Wapak Ruodhwa mochiwonwa Ndalo maber mar yueyoni;
En e momiyo chunywa kuwe Moloyo ndalo duto te.
Chunywa mondo obed mamor Kwagoyo erokamano;
Morno mondo opong` chunywa, Mosiko ma onge giko.
Kuve mar polo ma ni e chuny, En singruok madier mar yueyo
Moseketi e polo ku, Kar giko mar chandruok duto.

title: Sabato Mari, Ruoth
stanzas: Sabato mari, Ruoth, Jogi ruako gi mor;
Kwarito winjo wach mari Chunywa mondo paki.
Wamor kuom ndaloni Ma isewalo, Ruoth;
Wanaheri,Wanadendi, In Ruodh polo malo.
Jogi maler, gwedhgi! Bed kodwa kwalemo;
Ruoth, miwa mor kuom yueyoni, Kwarito chieng` maler.
Kidich piny korumo, Kwadar a thurwa ka;
Miwa dir kodi nyaka chieng` E dalani maler.

title: Ruoth, Wabiro Iri
stanzas: Ruoth, wabiro iri e Skundwa mar Sabato;
Wadwaro mond` igwedhwa Kwapuonjore Wachni
In mond` ibed Japuonjwa, Iyawnwa parowa,
Ni mondo ler mar polo Omeny chunywa adier.
Jo madongo biro Kachiel gi jo matindo,
Ni mondo wawinj weche Mag Yesu Japuonjwa;
Wan to waonge rieko, Enopuonjwa duto;
Wachikne itwa koro, Wach moro kik lalnwa.
Pinyni rach moloyo, Temruok nitie mang`eny ngang`;
To wanalo kuom Wachni Kwapidhogo e chuny
Miwa teg wang`wa kuomi, In ma Jares chunywa;
Wabed jogi madieri Nyaka ndalo giko.
Ruoth, kiwi` e piny ka Mar omo jo mariti,
Wan bende mond` iyudwa Kwakiyo bironi
Eka e pinyruodh polo E Sabato pile,
To wanachokre nyimi Ni mond` imed puonjwa.
chorus: Wan wamor kwachokore nyimi E skul mar Sabato;
Wan wageno yudo gwethni E Skundwa koro.

title: Mokwongo Ruodhwa Yesu
stanzas: Mokwongo Ruodhwa Yesu, noketonwa Sabato;
Kendo eka nowale, mogwedhogo ni dhano.
Tich mar ndalowa rumo, Tinde chieng` maler mar Ruoth;
Ka wadiro kuom chikne, Osingonwa gweth mare.
Polo gi piny, nokadhi, To Sabato ok norum;
Wanadir e piny manyien, Nyaka chieng` ma nyaka chieng`.
chorus: Wanamor ngang`, wanamor ngang`;
Wamor nikech ndalono, en Sabato mar Ruodhwa.

title: Kidira Chieng' Mar Yueyo
stanzas: Kidira chieng` mar yueyo, En chieng` maler mar mor;
Morunwa chieng` malong`o, Moloyo duto te;
To ji ma nyaka nene, Gipako ka giwer,
Maler, Maler, Maler,To Nyasaye achiel mang`won.
En chieng` maduogo chunywa, Mariembo wach malit;
En puoth Nyasaye malong`o Motimo pi mokuwe;
En soko mak oduono, Mochwernwa pi mang`ich;
En chieng` momiwa neno Piny ma nomiwa ku.
To tinde wach malerno Okonyo jo mojony;
Nyasaye oluongo joge, Gichokore kaachiel;
Giwinjo wach me polo, Ogolo richogi;
Oyueyo chunygi bende, Chieng`no gimor adier.

title: In Skul Marwa Mar Sabato
stanzas: In skul marwa mar Sabato In ka maler chutho;
Chunya koro gombo ywaya Mondo abi iri.
Chunya oyudo mor chutho E skul mar Sabato
Kasomo wach mar Ruoth Yesu Kaka nosethona.
Yesu Ruodha man gi hera, Oluongoa mondo
Adhi e skul mar Sabato Mond` achiwne chunya.
chorus: Ka maler (maler), Ka maber (maber),
Ka maler (maler), Ka maler (maler)
Chunya koro gombo ywaya Mondo abi iri.

title: Walamo Nyasaye Tinde
stanzas: Walamo Nyasaye tinde, Ka wabiro nyime ka;
Tinende waweyo tich, Ni mondo Nyasaye gwedhwa;
Ka wapako nyinge ka, Nobedi mana kodwa;
Ka wapako nyinge ka, Nobedi mana kodwa.
Kaka Ruodhwa yandi chon, ka nosetieko tichne,
Nobiro e Sabato, Wabiro bende koro;
Wan waparo ng`wonone, kak` omiyowa ngima;
Wan waparo ng`wonone, kak` omiyowa ngima.
Kata koro wadiro, Kaka En nochikowa,
Chieng`no wanadir kuno, Kama wanane Ruodhwa;
Eka wanabed gi kuwe, Bende kethruok wanawe;
Eka wanabed gi kuwe, Bende kethruok wanawe.
Injili mari mondo Omak chuny jo maricho;
Omed teko ni jonyawo, Okony jo machandore;
Kamano wanayud gwethni Ndalo duto nyak` ibi;
Kamano wanayud gwethni Ndalo duto nyak` ibi.

title: E Ndaloni Maler Mar Ruoth
stanzas: E ndaloni maler mar Ruoth Chunywa oyudo mor,
Kwaweyo paro gik mag piny,Kwaparo wach Nyasaye.
En kinde maber mar lemo, Owenwa richowa;
Wating`o dwondwa kwawacho, "Wuonwa manie polo."
Wamor kwawinjo weche kuwe moanwa ka Nyasaye,
Wamedo padore kuome, Kwachiko yor polo.
Ka golo richo e chunywa, Otamowa nyalo,
Nyasaye ong`eyo dwarowa, En to okonyowa.

title: Kidich Nyasaye
stanzas: Kidich Nyasaye, ndalo mamor, Meduru paro Jakonywa;
To tinende waweyo tich Kaka Nyasaye nowachonwa.
Nyasaye nowachonwa niya; Atieko gwedho Sabato;
To wadwaro mondo Nyasaye Omednwa gweth mare tinde.
Keturu chunyu kuom Yesu, To en nomiu kuwe mare;
Nitie wang`yo moro bende, To en modwaro witowa.
chorus: Paruru, kawuono, Kaka Nyasaye nochweyo piny;
Ka nochweyo polo gi piny, Koro eka nodiro En;
Wan bende tinende, wachokre diro gi Nyasaye.

title: Nyasaye Gweth Skundwa Mar Sabato
stanzas: Nyasaye, gwedh Skundwa mar Sabato,Bedi Jatendwa, kwachokore;
Tawa gi rieko gi herani,Kwaluwo yori.
Chwo, to gi mon, gi nyithindo be;Chokore mond` giwinj Wachni;
Muchi Maler obed Japuonjwa Kwasomo Wachni.
Weche mwawinjo e Skundwa ka; Mi mondo gimoki e chunywa;
Mondo wawuoth kuomgi e nyim ji;Kwaluwo ndachi.
chorus: Skund Sabato konyowa; Skund Sabato konyowa;
Mondo wasom Wach Nyasaye pile,Ndalo duto te.

title: Ndalo Mamor
stanzas: Ndalo mamor, ma Nyasachwa Nomiyowa e Eden chon;
Gik moko duto ma nie piny Jachwech nomiyogi yueyo.
Koro wadiro ndaloni Monyisowa tich mar Nyasaye
Kwapake ka, kendo kwawer, Chunywa opako tekone.
Pakuru Yesu ma notho,Kogolo Kethruok mag jopiny
Pakuru Wuod Nyasaye mang`won, Rembe Nochwer ni kethruokwa.
To pok kethruok ni tho adier;Thono Jawar noloyo,
Mondo wawuoth e yor Nyasaye,Mak waketho chikne maber.
Wadwaro chikne e chunywa ka,Wadiro tinendeni;
Kendo kochweyo Piny manyien Wanadir Sabato pile.

title: In Odira Mar Nyasaye
stanzas: In odira mar Nyasaye, In e ndalowa mar mor;
Chunye duto mor kodi, Kaka mor gi ler mar chieng`.
Mor mokuwe momiyowa ohoyo chunywa adier;
Okuweyo chuny e chandruok, Nyaka wanatiek wuodhwa.
En e ndalowa maler, mwawinje Wach Nyasachwa,
Kwapake kendo lame, mwayude ng`wono mare.

title: Wachokore Gi Mor Tinde
stanzas: Wachokore gi mor tinde, kidira mar Nyasaye;
Gi mor bende wawer nyimi kwapako nyingi ka.
Ot kama jogi lamoi Onego bed maler
Chuny ji mosayi odi ni Ilosogi maber.
Muya Maler, Jakony mang`won, Dak ie kanisa ni;
Teche liel saa duto Te Komenyo e piny.
Nyasaye man malo, miwa mor Nyaka chunywa oyieng`,
A waneni Wang` gi wang`, Kwamor ma nyaka chieng`.

title: Nyasaye, Gokiny Mond' Iwinja
stanzas: Nyasaye, gokiny mond` iwinja Ka dwonda pakoi;
In e malamoi koro Kating`oni wang`a.
Ageno Kristo ma Jawar, Masayo ni joge;
Onyiso Wuoro e polo, Yuakwa gi wendewa.
Muche mondo taya pile E yorene maler;
Onyisa tich moneg` atim, Atim gi chuny maler.
Jo moheri kendo luori, Nichopi dwarogi;
Nyasaye maduong` oritogi, Gineno ng`wonone.

title: Wago Ni Ruoth Erokamano
stanzas: Wago ni Ruoth Nyasachwa erokamano ngang`;
To oseritowa ma nyaka nend` okinyi.
Yesu ritwa gotienoni, kaka iseritowa chon.
To tichwa mar tinende koro oserumo;
Kendo waduogo paki, kendo wakwayoi,
Iritwa duto ka mang`won ka wanindo gotienoni.
Nyasaye, bedi Jakwadhwa, kaka nisingo chon
Nikech nitie e piny ka gik moko maricho
Yaye! Yesu, winjwa koro: warwa e gik maricho gi.

title: Bedi Kod An
stanzas: Bedi koda, piny koro yusona;
Polo to chido, Yesu bed koda;
Ka onge moro madhi konyoa,
Jakony jochan Iwuon, bedi koda.
Chieng` ndalona to koro rumona;
Gik managombo tinde kadhona;
Duto maneno lokore to tho,
In mak ilokori, bedi koda.
Pile achando, to adwaroi, In kendi inyalo teko mar Jachien;
In kendi itera, In midemboa,
E mudho be e chieng`, bedi koda.
Onge maluoro, In kibed koda, Eka masira dak oloya ngang`;
Tho to ok rach; to liel onyal ang`o?
An bend` aloyogi, ka In koda.
Chieng` tho inyisa kaka In nitho;
Ka piny ochido polo ek` orieny;
Chieng` cha noru, to mudho duto orum,
Kangima, kat` atho, bedi koda.

title: Wang' Chieng Koro Podhonwa
stanzas: Wang` chieng` koro podhonwa, mudho biro imo piny;
Sulwe to gi dwe koro Gotieno gidendo Ruoth.
In mimiyowa ngima In midak e polo ku,
Lerni mond` omeny chunywa,Ni mondo wang`e adier Ka In kodwa.
Herani obed kodwa E mudho mar otieno;
Ka nindo oterowa, Jopolo mondo ritwa Nyaka ru piny.
Kendo chieng` kiduogo, Ruoth, Gi teko mar kawo pinyruoth,
Nyasacha asayoi, Ruaka kanyo ma Intie, Polo malo.
chorus: En ma Jachwech! Nyasachwa maler ngang`, Nyasaye Maduong`;
Malaika me polo,To gi dhano man e piny, Wapakoi.

title: Yesu ,In Ma Jahoch Mar Chuny
stanzas: Yesu, In ma Jahoch mar chuny,Rita gotieno kanindo;
Bedi koda gotienoni,Nyaka piny chak oyawrena.
Ka pok anindo apari Kaka ihera pile ka;
Tich Satani aseyo chuth, In Nyasaye kende madalami.
Rita gotieno, godiechieng`, Ok dabed mangima mak In;
Bedi koda ka piny olil, To daluor tho da onge In.
Kaa e nindo, Igwedha; Dhi koda ka ma adhiye;
Pile kamano nyak` ibi Omo jogi moseyiei…..

title: Puothe Chiek E Pinje Duto
stanzas: Puothe chiek e pinje duto, Nitie cham mathoth maber;
E pewe gi holni duto Cham orito jokeyo.
Orgi ka chieng` wuok gokinyi, Orgi kata godiechieng`,
Kata saa ma wang` chieng` podho, pod onego gitim tich.
Un jokeyo ma Ruoth oro, Chokuru cham mosechiek;
To ka tich me piny ka rumo Unubed gi mor maduong`.
chorus: Ruodhwa, wan wayuakni koro, Ni mond` ior jokeyo;
Ni mondo gichok cham duto, Nyaka keyo rum chutho.

title: Winji Weche Ma Nondiki
stanzas: Winji weche ma nondiki mag Nyasaye,Keluru taith duto e od keno",
Waleuru chutho ni Ruodhwa maler,Osesingo Enogwedhu.
Udwaro ng`eyo teko Muya Maler? "Keluru taith duto e od keno";
Kuwe nobed e chunyu chutho saa gi saa,Ka uyudo gweth mowacho.
Gimoro ogeng` koso gweth mar Ruoth,Keluru taith duto e od keno;
Ji mamako wach mar Yesu Kristo Ruoth,Yudo hawi pile Kuome.
Ting`uru chunyu koro, dende ka Ruoth,Kukelo taith duto e od keno;
Chunywa mor moloyo, wanawer wende;
Waseyudo gweth mowacho.
chorus: "Keluru taith duto e od keno,Temauru e wach nogoni;
To an anaolnu gweth maduong`ng`ang`,Ma onge thuolo munyalo yie go."

title: Richona Diluok Gang'o?
stanzas: Richona diluok gang`o? Mana gi remb Yesu kende.
En ang`o ma dipwodha? Mana gi remb Yesu kende.
Onge gi ma dipwodha, to mana remb Yesu kende;
Aonge chandruok moro, mana gi remb Yesu kende.
Ok anyal yudo winjruok, mak mana gi remb Ruoth Yesu;
Bura to bwogo chunya, kaonge gi remb Ruoth Yesu.
Ma e genona kende, en e remo mar Ruoth Yesu;
Aonge ber kata kuwe, mak mana kuom remb Ruoth Yesu.
Gi moromo ji duto, en remo mar Ruodhwa Yesu;
Achiwo pakna duto, ni remono mar Ruoth Yesu.
chorus: To kuom richo magwa onge wang`yo moro Mwayudogo pwodhruok,
Mak mana gi remb Ruoth Yesu.

title: Ringra Namiyo In
stanzas: Ringra namiyoi, remba nochwer ni in;
Nawaroi adier e teko mar Satan;
Yandi remba nochwer ni in, ang`o mimiyo an?
Yandi remba nochwer ni in, ang`o mimiyo an?
Naweyo od Wuora, gi duong` ma nie polo;
Nachandora e piny, mondo anyisi yo;
Yandi achandora ni in, ang`o mitiyona?
Yandi achandora ni in, ang`o mitiyona?
Bura noloyoi, to an nayudo chwat;
Natho e Kalwari, mondo akony jopiny;
Yandi atho mond` awari; ang`o mitimona?
Yandi atho mond` awari; ang`o mitimona?

title: Adwaro Manyo Rombe Mabayo
stanzas: Adwaro manyo rombe mobayo, Mondo gibi ir Yesu Jakwath;
Anyisgi weche kaka owacho, "Biuru ira, aherou."
Adwaro manyo rombe mobayo, Mondo anyisgi Yesu Jawar;
Mondo akelgi, duto giyudi Ngima mochwere mosingonwa.
Mano e tich ma adwaro timo, tinde awinjo koluongae;
Mondo ating` rombe mosepodho, akelgi ir Jakwadha Maber.
chorus: Abiro dhiyo (koro) mondo amanygi,Rombe molal ma nobayo (chutho),
Mondo gidonj e kund (Yesu) Jawarwa;
Yesu Nyarombo ma notho ni wan (mothonwa).

title: Yesu Oluongoi Mondo Ibi
stanzas: Yesu oluongoi mondo ibi, Oluongoi kawuononi;
Nikech oneno kibayo marach, Kidhiyo mabor kode.
Yesu oluongo jo mool giyuwe, Oluongou kawuononi;
Kelne ting` duto machandi pile, En ok noriembi kodgi.
Yesu oriti, bi ire tinde, Oritoi kawuononi;
Bi ire, nyise richoni duto; Reti, to kik ideki.
Yesu osayo, dak iwinj dwonde; Yie winj dwonde, kawuononi;
Jogo moyie nyinge giniyud mor, Chungi, dhi ire piyo.
chorus: Oluongoi, oluongoi, Yesu (Yesu oluongoi tinde),
Yesu oluongi (Kawuono ibi), Oluongi kawuono ibi.

title: Nitie Wendo E Dhoot
stanzas: Nitie Wendo e dhoot, dak yawne; (Dak yawne Jawa);
Osebedo kanyo chon, dak yawne; Yawne ka pok okadho;
Ruakeuru, Ruoth Maler, Yesu Kristo Wuod Nyasaye, dak yawne.
Koro yawne, Ruodh chunyi; Dak yawne, to kideko nokadhi,
Dak yawne; Ruake nikech En Osiep, kendo enorit chunyi,
Enoriti nyaka chieng`, Dak yawne.
Winji dwonde kosayo; Dak yawne; En ma mondo iyiere,
Dak yawne; Ochungo e dhoot oko, Orito mond` iyawne,
Enomedni mor gi kuwe; Dak yawne.
Ruakuru wendo polo, dak yawne; Enotimni mor maduong`,
Dak yawne; Enowenu richou, kendo twech maru nogony,
Enoteru ka maler, dak yawne.

title: Yesu Oluongowa Koro
stanzas: Yesu oluongowa koro gi ng`wono, Oluongo in kod an be;
Ochungo oko e dhoranga chunywa,Korito in kod an be.
Yesu osayo, marang`o wakedo? Osayo in kod an be;
Wadeko nang`o kwachako ng`wonone? Ong`wonone kod an be.
Ndalo okadho, okadho mapiyo,Kadho ni in kod an be;
Pinyo biro rumo, tho chikowa koro,
Ochiko in kod an be.
Paruru hera maduong` ma osingo,mosingoni kod an be;
Kata waketho, oyie wenwa kethwa,
Oyie weni kod an be.
chorus: Mondo ibi....ibi....Un jo mojony mond` ubi;
Yesu oluongowa ire kod ng`wono,Jaketh mond` ibi ira.

title: Nawinjo Yesu Kowacho
stanzas: Nawinjo Yesu kowacho, "Bii Ira mond` iyue;
In ng`a mojony, bi mond` iyue, Iyud yueyo kuoma."
Nabirone kaka nabet, Najony, naol chutho;
Yesu nomiyoa yueyo, Omiyo chunya mor.
Nawinjo Yesu kowacho, "Namii pi ngima;
Ka riyo maki, bi ira, modhi, iyud ngima."
Nabirone mit namodho, pigno momiyoa;
Riyo norumo, to koro angima kuom Ruodha.
Nawinjo Yesu kowacho, "Abedo ler mar piny;
Ng`iya koro, mudho orum, nibed gi ler pile."
Nang`iyo Yesu, mayudo, ler kaka mar wang` chieng`;
Nawuothi koro e lerno nyaka wuodha norum.

title: Yesu Jakwath Madieri
stanzas: Yesu Jawkath madieri, Oluongou tinde;
Mondo udonj e kunde, To nunwang` kuwe maber.
Biuru jo madongo, Biuru nyithindo,
Donjur` e kul mar Yesu, To En Jakwath maber.
Yesu Jakwath madieri, Nochiwo ngimane;
Oluongo jo moruenyo, Mondo gibi ire.
Returu a e kethruok, Yesu owachonu;
Donjur` ekul mar Yesu, To En Jakwath maber.
Kwadeko to wafuwo, Satan ni e piny ka,
Kotemo mako rombe, odwaro negogi.
Yesu Jakwath madieri, oluongou koro;
Donjur` e kul mar Yesu, To en Jakwath maber.
chorus: Oluongowa nikech oherowa, "Un jo moruenyo biuru ira. "
Ochungo koritowa gi kinda, Yesu Jakwadh maler.

title: Winji Dwond Yesu Kawuono
stanzas: Winji duond Yesu kawuono, "Ng`a madhiyo tich tinde? Ji mathoth ma pok ong`eyo, Ng`a madhiyo nyisogi?"
Yesu chikowa ahinya, Enopogwa pok maber;
Ng`a madwokne piyo piyo, "Era e; ora, ora."
Mit ki kalo nam, dotami, Kat` idwaro puonjo mwa;
To inyalo puonjo jou, Mabedo e mudho ka;
Lu ni ji duto moketho,Yesu nosethonigi;
Bende wachi ni nyithindo,Yesu e moherogi.
Mitki ok dibed jayalo, Mobedo kaka jarit nyiso ji wang` yor ngima, Yorno mochiko polo.
To gi lemo, bende michni, Inyalo konyo tich Ruoth;
Kamano nichal kod Harun, Kitego jotich Nyasaye.
Ka Yesu oluongi pile, Ka ji thoth madwaro tho,
Kik iwach awacha kende, "Onge moro ma datim,"
Yie tichno ma Yesu miyi, Tich mamiyo chunyi mor;
En koluongi, dwoke piyo, " Era e, ora, ora."

title: Wasewinjo Wach Maber
stanzas: Wasewinjo wach maber, Yesu ni Jawarwa;
To keuru wechegi, Yesu ni Jawarwa;
Landuru e pinje te, puonjuru ji wach maber,
Ruodhwa e mochikowa, Yesu ni Jawarwa.
Weruru pile pile, Yesu ni Jawarwa;
Ne otho kendo nochier, Yesu ni Jawarwa.
Weruru ni ji matuo, ka giwinjo rem malit,
Weruru e kar liete, Yesu ni Jawarwa.
Ne wakia wechegi, Yesu ni Jawarwa;
Koro wan wamor nikech Yesu ni Jawarwa,
Ne wadak e mudho chuth, ti waneno ler Nyasaye,
E momiyo mudho tur, Yesu ni Jawarwa.
Yaluru e piny ma ka, Yesu ni Jawarwa
Yaluru e pinje te, Yesu ni Jawarwa;
Kik wadeki, kik waling`, nyaka Yesu oduogi,
Nyaka ji duto ong`e, Yesu ni Jawarwa.

title: Ng'a Mowinjo Dwond Ruoth
stanzas: Ng`a mowinjo dwond Ruoth, oneg` oyie;
Oland wachne mondo ji duto winje;
Wachne mond` odhiyo e pinje duto;
Ng`a mowinjo dwonde, bi.
"Ng`a mobiro ira," Yesu wacho,"Kik odeki to mondo obi piyo.
An e Yo, Adiera, kendo an Ngima;
Ng`a mowinjo dwonda, bi."
Ng`a madwaro chutho, osesingone,
Ng`a mobiro piyo ok nodog nono;
Ng`a madwaro chutho, noyudi ngima;
Ng`a moyie mondo, obi.
chorus: Ka ng`ato winjo, ka ng`ato winjo, Ni mond` okow wachne nyaka giko piny;
Wuonwa ma Jahera e maluongowa;
Ng`a moyie mondo obi.

title: Dhoranga Polo Yawore
stanzas: Dhoranga polo yawore, Wayud kinde mar neno
Ler moa e msalap Yesu, Manyisowa herane.
Rangano pod oyawore Ni joma richo duto,
Madongo gi matindo be, Magombo yudo warruok.
Watimuru kinda koro, Wayie ng`wono maduong`no;
Kwating`o msalaba koro, Wanayudi osimbo.
Ka wasekalo aora, To wanawe msalaba;
Ruoth nomiwa ngima mak rum, Wanahere mochwere.
chorus: Ng`wono maduong`, miwuoro ngang`, Kaka rangano yaworena;
Ni an, ni an, Oyawore ni an.

title: Jathieth Maduong' Osudo Ka
stanzas: Jathieth maduong` osudo ka, En Yesu ma Jakonywa;
Wachne omiyo chunya mor, Yaye, winjuru dwonde.
Oseweyoni richoni, Winji Yesu kowacho;
Chunyi koro obed gi kuwe, Kichiko wang` yor polo.
Wadend Nyarombono motho; Koro ayie kuom Yesu.
Ahero nying` mar Jawarna, Ahero nying`no, Yesu.
Nying`no ogolo richona, Onge maromo kode;
Chunya mor nade kawinjo Nying`no maber mar Yesu.
Koduogo chiwo osimbo, Osimb ngima mar locho
Eka wanabedi bute, Wanadend Jawar Yesu.
chorus: Wer mamit mar jopolo, Ka gipako Ruoth Yesu,
Nying` moloyo nying` duto, Yesu kende, Yesu.

title: Richo Oketho Ji Malit
stanzas: Richo oketho ji malit, Okelo buch Nyasaye;
Doteri ka marach chutho, to Yesu gudoi.
Yesu otho nitho adier, misango mar Nyasaye;
Oluoko kethni duto te, gi rembe ma nochwer.
Ee, Yesu En e yo adier, materoi maber;
En bende to owuothoe, odwaro kowo in.
Bi chak iwuothie koro ka, ka pod ingima in;
Yesu owuon oluongoi, oluongoi adier.
chorus: Gene chutho! Gene chutho! Gene koro ka;
En noresi! En noresi! En noresi ka.

title: Yesu Okadho
stanzas: Yesu okadho, Yesu okadho, Un jo mamuofni biuru ire;
Yesu noruaku, kendo nochangu,
Wengeu noyepi mondo unen;
Biuru! Yesu nomiu neno.
Yesu okadho, Yesu okadho, Biuru, rang`onde, ni Jathieth ji;
Rembe nochwernu, ni mond` owaru,
To enowinju kuluonge koro;
Yesu okadho, odwaro konyu.
Yesu okadho, Yesu okadho, Un jo moketho, biuru ire;
Tinde wasayu; yieuru koro;
Biuru piyo ka pod oluongu;
Un jo moketho, yieuru Yesu.

title: Ngima Machiek Mawango
stanzas: Ngima machiek mawango, chalo gi pot yath malwar,
Chalo g`oboke matop, ret piyo;
Ndalo nyiso wa adier ni ng`wono chiegni rumo,
Ng`wono nyalo rumoni ret piyo.
Thiepe mag piny biro lal, joma tindo biro ti,
Ok in gi kinde malach, Ret piyo,
Ka Nyasaye luongoi, In jaricho we bayo
Dipo kisik` e richo, Ret piyo.
Ndalo to kadho piyo, tho kod bura chiegini,
Ringi idhi ir Yesu, Ret piyo,
Akwayi ibed mariek dipo ndalo ong`adi,
Kendo ilal mochwere Ret piyo.
In jaricho winj duonde, yier Yesu mondo otelni,
Eka jopolo nomor, Ret piyo,
Ringi iae mudho, Bi ipuodhri ir Yesu,
Yie ichak wuoth tinende, Ret piyo.
chorus: Ret piyo, Ret piyo; Ka duond Yesu luongii Ret piyo,
Kisikori e richo, Niyud dhoudi kolor
To yuakni nobed kayiem- Ret piyo.

title: Yie Yesu Odonj E Chunyi
stanzas: Ka iol gi ting`o chandruok richo; Ruak Yesu Jawar e chunyi;
Ka idwaro chako ngima manyien, Yie Yesu odonj e chunyi.
Ka ikuyo nikech richo magi, Ruak Yesu Jawar e chunyi;
Soko mar Puodhruok iyudo kuome, yie Yesu odonj e chunyi.
Ka nitie temruok motamo chunyi, Ruak Yesu Jawar e chunyi;
Ka en tem ma pinyni ok onyal golo, Yie Yesu odonj e chunyi.
Ka osiepni machon oweyi, Ruak Yesu Jawar e chunyi;
Pim osiep Yesu gi mago machon, Yie Yesu e chunyi.
Ka diher wero wend jomolocho, Ruak Yesu e chunyi;
Ka diher donje dala mar yueyo, Yie Yesu donj e chunyi.
chorus: Ko-ro we paruok chutho, ko-ro we kwede kendo,
Koro yawne dhod chunyi, yie Yesu odonj e chunyi.

title: Be Iseyudo Jawar Maber?
stanzas: Be Iseyudo Jawar maber, moloyo duto me piny,
Mochiwo ngima mar wari, motho chuth ni richoni.
Be iseyudo Jawar maber mokadho e liel ne in,
Mochodo tuech mar thoni, tekone nyalo resi.
Be iseyudo Jawar maber, be ing`eyo muolo gi kuwe,
Mopong`o chuny ji magene, ma heragi tut kuome.
Be iseyudo Jawar maber, dware ma onge deko,
Bil mitne maonge deko, nogol richowa oko.
chorus: Be iseyudo jawar maber, Dikwed hera ma kama?
Adier onge hera maduong`, chiwo ngimani ni Ruoth. (Ni Ruoth).

title: Bi Ka Yesu
stanzas: Bi ka Yesu, bi ka Yesu, Bi ka Yesu koro;
Koro ini bika Yesu, Bi ka Yesu koro.
En Jakonyi, En Jakonyi, En Jakonyi koro;
Koro En onyalo konyi, Bi ka Yesu koro.
En gi teko, En gi teko, En gi teko koro;
Yesu En onyalo duto, Bi ka Yesu koro.
In kidware, In kidware, In kidware koro;
Yesu koro bendo dwari, Bi ka Yesu koro.
Sae koro, Sae koro, Sae Yesu koro;
Yesu ruako joma saye, Bi ka Yesu koro.
En owinji, En owinji, En owinji koro;
Yesu koro winjo duto, Bi ka Yesu koro.
En oluoki, En Oluoki, En oluoki koro;
Rembe emoluoko chunyi, Bi ka Yesu koro.
Gene Kende, Gene kende, Gene kende koro;
Bi ire to kik ideki, Bi ka Yesu koro.

title: Winji Jawar Ni E Dhoot
stanzas: Winji Jawar ni e dhoot irwake, irwake, irwake;
Oseduong`o gi kinda irwake, irwake, irwake.
En osiepni madieri, irwake, irwake, irwake;
En onyalo siroi irwake, irwake, irwake.
Kik oduong` kayiem nono, irwake, irwake, irwake;
Dipo ka ok oduogo irwake, irwake, irwake.
Winji duonde mar hera, irwake, irwake, irwake;
Ruake e chuny gi mor irwake, irwake, irwake.
chorus: Jawar ema ochungo e dhoot, Oseng`iyo kendo orito;
Yaw chuny mar richo malach, Ruak Jawar maber iye, irwake, irwake.

title: Un Jo Mojony, Biuru
stanzas: "Un jo mojony, biuru, Namiu yueyo, An;"
Winjuru dwond Ruoth Yesu, owuoyonwa koro;
Onyisowa ng`wonone, kaka nowenwa keth;
Gi mor mar chuny mosiko, gi hera mochwere.
"Biuru, un muruenyo, to anamiu ler;"
Dwond Yesu `hoyo chunywa ka mudho imowa
Chunywa nepong` gi kuyo, Wang`yo noselalnwa;
To osemiyowa mor, Wadende koro.
Un jo mool, motho, to Yesu oluongou;
Odwaro miu ngima, nokonyu e lwenju;
Jasigu tek ahinya, Lweny kedore mager;
To waseyudo teko mar loyo jasikwa.
"Ng`a manade mabiro ok anajwang`e ngang`;"
Ok wanyal go kiawa kwawinjo dwond Yesu;
Oluongowa - moketho, wan jo mak winjre ngang`,
Gi herane gi ng`wono; Wabironi, Ruodhwa.

title: Chungo E Adiera Kaka Daniel
stanzas: Chungo e adiera e winjo chik Nyasaye;
Waluor jo manok moyie jogo gin lang Daniel.
Ji ma rateke gilal nikech ok gi chung`;
Ma dobedo jo Nyasaye da gin gi lang Daniel.
Ji mathoth ma rabede ma wuotho e piny;
Gore piny matek malich komonj gi lang Daniel.
Ting` wach mar ritruok malo nyaka ilochi;
Tam Satan gogandane riwri gi lang Daniel.
chorus: Chungi kaka Daniel, kata in kendi;
Dwar ichungi motegno mond` iland wachno.

title: Nitie Remo Ma Nochwer
stanzas: Nitie remo ma nosechwer, Ne en remb Immanuel;
Jo maricho koluokoree, Gipwodhore maler.
Jamecho cha e kar thone Noyudo mor kuome;
To an bende ma ok aler, Noluokna kethna te.
Remb Nyarombo ma nonegi, Obedo gi teko
Mar pwodho jogo magene, Ni kik giketh kendo.
Nyaka nageno remono Mochwer e Kalwari,
Apako hera mar Jawar, Moherowa kama.
Ruoth, kat` an ng`a marach kama,Kuom ng`wononi maduong`
Isewara, ilosona, Kar bet ma nyaka chieng`.
To kisechiera a e liel, Miresa a e piny
Anapaki pile gi wer, Kuom mar miwarago.
chorus: Gipwodhore maler, Gipwodhore maler; Jo maricho koluokore, Gipwodhore maler.

title: Ruoth Yesu, Agombo Bedo Nga'ti
stanzas: Ruoth Yesu, agombo bedo ng`ati chuth;
In mond` idag e chunya pile pile;
Gol kuoma maricho gi tim ma ok ler;
Luoka gi rembi mond` abedi mapoth.
Ruoth Yesu, para gi e polo malo;
Ikonya ni mond` achiwrani chutho,
Misango mangima, maler, malong`o;
Luoka gi rembi mond` abedi mapoth.
Ruoth Yesu, akwayoi gi chuny mamuol,
Arito koro ni mondo igwedha;
Rembi mond` oguda kuom duto mak ler;
Luoka gi rembi mond` abedi mapoth.
Ruoth Yesu, aling` nyimi ka ageno,
Ni mondo ichwena chuny manyien chutho;
To jogo makwayi ok iniriembgi;
Luoka gi rembi mond` abed mapoth.
chorus: Luoka mapoth, iluoka mapoth;
Pwodha gi rembi, mond` abedi mapoth.

title: Abiro Ni Msalaba
stanzas: Abiro ni msalaba, an ayom, an ng`a modhier;
Aweyo gi piny duto, Mond` akwo e msalaba.
Ayuakni koro, Jawar, Richo e moloyoa;
Yesu to wacho niya, "Anawe gi duto te."
Achiwoni duto te, ngimana kod tekona;
Chunya kod ringra bende, Nobed mari nyaka chieng`.
Kuom rembi manochwerna, aseluokora koro;
Aweyo gombo duto, analuwi, Jawarna.
Yesu bi, ipong` chunya, mond` abed molony kuomi;
Abedi maler chutho, mond` apaki nyaka chieng`.
chorus: An agenoi kende, Nyarombo mar Kalwari;
Ruoth akulora ni In; Yesu Ruoth, mond` iwara.

title: Agombo Bedo Gi Ruodha
stanzas: Agombo bedo gi Ruodha, nikech agombo bet maler;
En koluoka gi pi gi mach, nabed maler, nabed mapoth.
Kinyisa, kendo ipuonja, nabed mamor, nabed moil;
Ka chunya ler, ka chunya poth, nabed mamor, mamor chutho.
Ka pod arem bedo maler, ok anyal ng`eyo puonj maber;
Puonja, Muya Maler, Jahoch; Iluok chunya, abed mapoth.
Awuon e chunya, ee Ruodha, aseko kwerora matek,
Ni mond` abed maler e Ruoth; To pok ayudo teko, Ruoth.
chorus: Ruodha, luoka abed maler; Chunya mondo obed mapoth;
Kata kod mach niluok chunya, richona mond` orum chutho.

title: Analu Bang' Yesu
stanzas: Analu bang` Yesu Nyarombo Nyasaye, Noluoka gi rembe mosechwer;
Hera mare e momiyo `thonwa ka, Noluoka gi rembe mosechwer.
Analu bang` Yesu Kristo Jakonywa, Noluoka gi rembe mosechwer;
Rembe e moromo mana ji duto, Noluoka gi rembe mosechwer.
Analu bang` Yesu Kristo jagwethna, Noluoka gi rembe mosechwer;
Enoyie ni mond` adonji e polo, Noluoka gi rembe mosechwer.
Kethna duto ni mond` ahul ni Nyasaye, Noluoka gi remb Yesu Wuode;
Mondo miya ngimane ma nyaka chieng`, Noluoka gi rembe mosechwer.
chorus: Noluoka gi rembe, Enoluoka gi remb Nyarombo;
Kata Kethruok dich e chunya manade, Noluoka gi rembe mosechwer.

title: Asebayo Mabor Kod Ruoth
stanzas: Asebayo mabor kod Ruoth, koro aduogo;
Asebayo marach chutho, koro aduogo.
Asebayo ndalo mang`eny, Koro aduogo;
Chunya olokreni, Ruodha, koro aduogo.
Awito keth kod tim marach, koro aduogo;
Nagen herani kod wachni, koro aduogo.
Yesu Ruodha, isewara, An abironi;
Nitho e Kalwari ni an, An abironi.
Pwodha gi rembi mochwerna, an abironi;
Luoka, abed maler chutho, Ruoth, abironi.
chorus: Abiro, abiro, Ruoth abironi;
Yie mondo iruaka chuth, Ruoth, abironi.

title: Jawar Owachona
stanzas: Jawar owachona, "Tekoni tin adier;
Oneg` iritri galam, iniyud duto kuoma."
Ruoth, koro aneno, teko mari kende;
Manyalo pwodha maler, kendo golna chuny matek.
Aonge gi maber, ageno ng`wononi;
Luoka, guda, pwodha chuth, gi remb Nyaromb Kalwari.
Ka nachung` e nyim duong`, nabed molony kuome;
Gi loch duto maayudo, naket e tiend Ruoth Yesu.
chorus: Yesu nochulo, gopena duto;
Richo nosekethoa, noluoka gi rembe.

title: Yesu, Kar Msalabani
stanzas: Yesu, kar msalabani, Nitie soko maler,
Aora machango tuo, Machwer a Kalwari.
Kanyo e kar msalaba, Herani noyuda;
An naluor, to In ing`won, Nimenya gi lerni.
Miya paro thoni, Ruoth, Kod rembi mochwerna;
Konya bed buti pile, Ni mond` ichik wuodha.
Ruodha, mond asiki Kanyo but msalaba,
Kakiyo be kageno, Biro mari, Ruodha.
chorus: Kalwari, Kalwari, E kar pakna pile,
Nyaka chunya noyudi, Yueyo e par Nyasaye.

title: Duto Amiyo Ruoth Yesu
stanzas: Duto amiyo Ruoth Yesu, amiye chunya duto;
Anahere ndalo duto, analuwe pile ka.
Duto amiyo Ruoth Yesu, anagone chonga piny;
An aweyo mor mag pinyni, kawa Yesu, kawa chuth.
Duto amiyo Ruoth Yesu, Losa, abed nyathini;
Miya Roho mari, Ruodha, Orita ndalo duto.
Duto amiyo Ruoth Yesu; An ayudo mor maduong`,
Kaparo kaka nowara, nadend nyinge nyaka chieng`.
chorus: Duto mag Yesu; Duto mag Yesu;
An amiye duto koro, En ma Jawarna.

title: Yesu Luongi, We Ting'ni Mar Richo
stanzas: Yesu Luongi, we ting`ni mar richo;
Nitie teko e remb Nyarombo;
Mondo ilo gik maricho duto,
Kuom teko mar remb Nyarombo.
Yie we paro kod sunga mar chunyi;
Nitie teko e remb Nyarombo;
Bi bed maler kuom remb yadh Kalwari,
Kuom teko mar remb Nyarombo.
Yie mond` ibed matar moloyo pe,
Nitie teko e remb Nyarombo;
Noruch keth duto ibedi maler,
Kuom teko mar remb Nyarombo.
Yie mondo itim tich Ruodhwa Yesu,
Nitie teko e remb Nyarombo;
Yie mond` idend nyinge ndalo duto,
Kuom teko mar remb Nyarombo.
chorus: Nitie te...ko, teko miwuoro, (Nitie, teko, teko),
E remo mar Jawar; Nitie te...ko, teko miwuoro,
E remono mar Nyarombo.

title: Nitie Ng'ama Noyie Tho Mondo Owara
stanzas: Nitie ng`ama noyie tho mondo owara,
Mondo an marach ayud ngima.
Kendo yor kalwari noluwo kodhi tho,
Mondo owe richona duto.
En mang`won kendo ber, okecha pile ka
Oluoko chunya be mochido.
Aonge bura moro, an thuolo chutho
Nikech kethna duto nosegur.
Anasik kuom Jawarna, ok anaweye,
Anawuoth gi mor ndalo duto,
Ka awer gi dhoga kod wend pak e chunya,
Nikech kethna duto nosegol.
chorus: Richona osegur, richona osegur,
Noyie ting`o richona malich;
Yesu nodhi e tho gi chandruok malich ngang`,
Koyie ting`o richoga duto.

title: In Kiol Nikech Chandruok
stanzas: In Kiol nikech chandruol e chunyi,
Dhi inyis Yesu parruokni duto;
Onge osiep moro kaka Yesu,
Dhi inyis Yesu kende.
Kata mirima ohingo chunyi,
Dhi inyis Yesu parruokni duto;
Ting` mapek kodwaro loyo chunyi,
Dhi inyis Yesu Kende.
In kiluoro chandruok gi masiche,
Dhi inyis Yesu parruokni duto;
Kik ichandori ni gi mabiro,
Dhi inyis Yesu kende.
Ka luoro mar tho obwogo chunyi,
Dhi inyis Yesu parruokni duto;
Kidwaro bedo e pinyruodh polo,
Dhi inyis Yesu kende.
chorus: Dhi inyis Yesu chandruokni duto,
En e Osiep migeno;
Kata richo osepong`o chunyi,
Dhi inyis Yesu Kende.

title: Nitie Ngima Kwang'iyo Msalaba
stanzas: Nitie ngima kwang`iyo msalaba;
Yesu wacho, "Ng`iyauru."
Mwandu mar piny en gi mokadho,
Mwandu mosiko ni kuom Ruoth Yesu.
Ka nakwongo ng`iyo wang` Jawarna,
Nong`iyoa gi wang` mang`won;
Kendo ka temruok dwaro loya,
Nayud teko kang`iyo msalaba.
Nang`i msalaba ndalona duto,
Kageno singruok mar Nyasaye;
Satani ok onyalo loyo Jogo mageno teko mar polo.
chorus: Kwang`iyo, nitie ngima, Ka wang`iyo msalaba.
Wanayud warruok chutho, Kwang`iyo yor Kalwari.

title: Ka Satan Otemi
stanzas: Ka Satan otemi, kodwaro loyi,
Ka chunyi oani e masicheni;
Par Yesu Jawarni ndalo mokonyi,
En nosiri koro, pod oheroi.
Koso in Jakristo man gi chuny mapek,
Ting`o msalabani bedo matek?
Par Yesu Jawarni, Chuny mapek noa,
Iniyud mor koro, kaa e piny ka.
Kineno jo moko man gi pith mag piny,
Mwandugi nokadhi ndalo giko piny;
Par Yesu Jawarni, Ruoth polo malo.
Gen moloyo Kristo gi pok masiko.
Kendo e lwenje mond` ibed ng`at mager,
Wach mar miriambo lo gi wach maber;
Yesu ma Jawarni gi malaika,
Ginimor moloyo e polo kucha.
chorus: Kwan gweth magi, hul achiel achiel,
Kwan gweth magi, ne tich mar Nyasaye;
Kwan gweth magi, hul achiel achiel,
Kendo iniwuor gi ma Ruoth notimo.

title: Anayie Ruoth Yesu Kende
stanzas: Anayie Ruoth Yesu kende, asewinjo wach mare;
Onge gi manyalo loyo ng`ato mogeno Yesu.
Kethna duto awe kuome, enoluoka gi rembe;
Enorita nyaka chieng` ka notera ka Nyasaye.
Koro ok aluor gi moro, chunya koro genoi;
Kata yora timo mudho, Yesu ni lerna pile.
Chunya amiyo Ruoth Yesu, ringra bende amiye;
Ndalo duto enorita nyaka chieng`ma noduogi.
chorus: Anayie, anayie, anayie wachne kende;
Anayie, anayie, anayie wachne kende.

title: Geno Kristo Kelonwa Mor
stanzas: Geno Kristo kelonwa mor, Kwawuotho e piny ka;
Ohoyo chunywa kwawuotho, E pinyni mar chandruok;
Ohoyo chunywa kwawutho, E pinyni mar chandruok
Onyisowa piny mar yueyo, Kar dak mar jo maler;
Wanarom gi jomwahero, Pogruok onge kendo;
Wanarom gi jomwahero, pogruok onge kendo.
E piny ma keth ok nyal donjo, Ok wanayud temruok;
To wanabed gi mor maber, Ma ok nyal kethre ngang`;
To wanabed gi mor maber, Ma ok nyal kethre ngang`.
Pi wang` onge ka maberno, Tho ok nodonj kanyo;
Duto modak kanyo, nochal Gi jomalaika;
Duto modak kanyo, nochal Gi jomalaika.
Ndalo mondo runwa piyo; Jawarwa Yesu, bi!
Wagombo neni kak` ibet, Wadag kodi kucha;
Wagombo neni kak` ibet, Wadag kodi kucha.

title: Nyasaye Noolnwa Gweth Polo
stanzas: Nyasaye noolnwa gweth polo, Kaka koth chwe e piny;
E ma nosingo kod joge, E ma nokelnwa kony.
Nyasaye noolnwa gweth polo, Mond` ochiew chunywa koro;
Kaka koth biro maduong`ngang`, Aore duto kopong`.
Nyasaye noolnwa gweth polo, Enonyiswa ng`wonone;
Olnwa ni mondo wachungi, Mondo wadongni, Ruodhwa.
Nyasaye noolnwa gweth polo, Mondo ogudhnwa koro;
Wanahul kethowa duto, Yienwa, Yesu, kwaluongi.
chorus: Gweth moa e polo, E ma wadwaro chutho;
Ruodhwa, ikechwa, wasayi; Ole kuomwa tinende.

title: Ka Chandruok Osudo Machiegni Kodi
stanzas: Ka chandruok osudo machiegni kodi,
Ka yo man e nyimi otimo mudho,
Nitie ler mogwedhi man kuom Ruoth Yesu,
Monego ing`i mondo ilo temruok.
Kata ok ing`eyo tiend ting`ni mapek,
Mosechandi e ngimani e piny ka;
Mond` iting` msalapi e chandruok duto,
Kendo igen Yesu ndalo duto te.
Dhi nyime kuom yie mondo ilo temruok,
King`eyo ka Jawar ni buti pile;
Kata ka lweny tek to kik chunyi oa,
Jawar nokonyi mondo ilo temruok.
Kata lweny ger chutho, kata kuyo thoth,
Kata temruok duong` machiegni hingoi;
Ruoth ni buti pile nomiyi teko,
Mar loyo temruok duto mabironi.
chorus: Ne ler Yesu kaka orieny maler,
Ler mogwedhi mariembo luoro;
Ng`i wang` Yesu mudho noringi
Gen Yesu kende nikech en machiegni.

title: Beduru Gi Yie
stanzas: Beduru gi yie kaka Yesu, kaka noteme gi Satani;
To En noloyogo e thim, Nyasaye ne mor ahinya.
Beduru gi yie kaka Yohana, kaka notiyo ni Nyasaye;
Notere e chula mar Patimo, Ne oyudo chwat malit.
Beduru gi yie kaka Yakobo, kaka nobedo gi Nyasaye;
Moneno ngas moa polo, Jomalaika ne gintie.
Beduru giyie kaka Yosef, kaka nobedo gi Nyasaye;
Noloyo tem ma nothung`e, E od Ruoth Farao.
Beduru giiyie kaka Elija, kaka nobedo gi Nyasaye;
Notere e polo kongima, e gari moliel mach.
Beduru gi yie kaka Daniel, ma nene obole e bur sibuoche;
Gokinyi noyude kongima, Dario ne owuoro ngang`.
Beduru gi yie kaka Esta, kaka nokonyo Joyahudi;
Nokonyo chunye mang`eny, Nikech wach mar Nysaye.
Beduru gi chuny mabeyo, kaka chuny Jonabi;
Jo moko notho gi ligangla, jo moko negitho gi mach.
chorus: Nyithind Nyasaye moruru, weruru duto Alleluia;
Beduru kulamo Nyasaye, kugene ndalo duto te.

title: Chunyi Dich Nikech Parruok
stanzas: Chunyi dich nikech parruok, Dak imi Yesu kinde?
Weche piny otweyoi, Dak imi Yesu kinde?
Ne ochungo e dhoot Odwong`o mond` iyawne;
Winje koro kosayo- Dak imi Yesu kinde.
Saa okadhoni nono, Dak iti tich mar Yesu?
Nyasaye nomiyi teko, Mond iti tich mar Yesu,
Dak item loyo richo, Dak ikony jo moketho,
Dwaro jogo mobayo yo, Dak iti tich mar Yesu?
In midwaro gik mag piny, Dak ipar Yesu Ruodhwa?
Yaw chunyi ni tim maber, Kitiyo ni Ruoth Yesu,
Mor mag piny gi mwandune, Kelo mor e chuny dhano;
To ok en mor mosiko; Dak wami Yesu kinde?
Ka dwabed pot yath kende; To ok wanyag olembe.
Luetewa nobed nono, Ndalo maduong` mar keyo;
Onge gi mwakel chieng`no, Tichwa nobedi kayiem,
Mi ok wanayud mor ngang`, Kwaromo gi Ruoth Yesu.

title: Un Muhero Ruoth Polo
stanzas: Un muhero Ruodh polo, Weruru kuwuotho ka;
Wendewa omedo duong` Ni Yesu ma Jawarwa.
Wan wadwaro piny maber, Kaka kwerewa machon;
Yesu e motelonwa, Obedo Jakwath mang`won.
Kik waluor masiche wuoth, thurwa koro chiegini;
Wanane Jatelowa, Ok nowewa nyaka chieng`.
Wuothuru, Jowetewa; Kik wariwre e wang`yo;
Yueyo to oritowa, Wanacham mwandu kuno.

title: Nyasaye Ni Lerna
stanzas: Nyasaye ni lerna, koro ok aluor!
E mudho , e chieng`, to En koda pile;
Owara e kethruok, ohoyo chunya;
Amor gi Yesu moherowa kama.
Nyasaye ni lerna, e chandruok duto,
Kata ok anene, chunya ogene;
Mudho mar Satani ok anoloya
Ka Yesu obedo koda.
Nyasaye ni lerna, kendo tekona;
Ang`eyo e tekono anyalo lo;
Oumo yomna gi duong` mare;
Kawuotho gi Yesu koro ok aluor.
Nyasaye ni lerna, adware kende;
Mudho onge chutho ka an kod Yesu;
Koro En Jawarna, bende Jakonywa,
Gi Malaika anapake pile.
chorus: Nyasaye ni lerna, morna gi wenda;
Otelona pile e piny ka marach;
Nyasaye ni lerna, morna gi wenda;
Otelona pile e piny ka marach.

title: Koro Wagenoi
stanzas: Koro wagenoi, Yesu mar Kalwari, Yesu Ruodhwa;
Winjwa kwalamoi, Gol kethruokwa oko,
Konywa bedo maber pile pile.
Ruoth, nyiswa ng`wononi, Jiw chunywa,itegwa,
Mednwa geno; Kaka nisethonwa,
Miwa heri chutho Gi hera mosiko, Mak lokore.
Ka wadak e piny ka, ka chunywa okuyo,
Yesu konywa Ruodhwa, dag e chunywa,
Bedi Jahochwa ka Chieng` moro iterwa Polo malo.

title: Ang'eyo Wuonwa Ong'eyo
stanzas: Ang`eyo Wuonwa ong`eyo, yembe madigeng` wang` yora;
To onyalo riembo mudho, komiya ler marieny chutho,
Komiya ler marieny chutho.
Ang`eyo Wuonwa ong`eyo, yath madikuwena rem mara;
Komula gi luete maler, nochangi chunyani matuwo,
nochangi chunyani matuwo.
Ang`eyo Wuonwa ong`eyo, ayom ok anyal wasika;
Kendo nojuka kuom tichna, kendo norita nyaka chieng`,
Kendo norita nyaka chieng`.
Ang`eyo Wuonwa ong`eyo, saa ma wuodha norum e piny;
To mad saano yaye Ruodha, yuda kapadora kuomi
Yuda kapadora kuomi.
chorus: Ose.......ng`eyo, yembe madigeng` wang`yora.
(Oseng`eyo.......adier chutho, yembe duto madigeng` wang`yora.)
Ose....ng`eyo, nogeng`na yembe makudho.
(Nogeng`na yembe duto makudho).

title: Kat' Abed Jaketh Maduong'
stanzas: Kat` abed jaketh maduong`, Remb Yesu nochwer ni an;
Nothona ni kik atho, To adag kode polo;
Asiki but Jawarna, An ng`ate, to En Ruodha.
Hera Yesu duong` chutho, Oyombo polo malo,
Tut moloyo nam matut, Osiko ma nyaka chieng`,
Herane noywayoa, Nogola e mudho ka.
Kat` abed jaketh maduong`, Kristo oseng`wonona;
Dwarona kod kuyona, Mago duto ong`eyo;
Okonya e lwenje chuny, Ngimana okan kuome.

title: Adwari Saa Duto
stanzas: Adwari saa duto, Yesu mang`won;
Adwaro tekoni, to an ayom.
Adwari saa duto, sudi buta;
Satan ok oloya, ka an abuti.
Adwari saa duto, e mor gi tuo;
To an kaonge in, anyal ang`o?
Adwari saa duto, puonja wachni;
Tim kak` idwaro In, an nyathini.
Adwari saa duto, Yesu Ruodha;
An ng`ati chutho, an, ndalo duto.
chorus: Adwari yaye adwari, Saa duto adwari;
Yesu, igwedha koro, abironi.

title: Kata Ka Abedo Gi Ngima Maber
stanzas: Kata ka abedo gi ngima maber, kata ka ayudo chandruok;
Kata abet nade, imiya ng`eyo, Kuomi to anyalo
To anyalo bet gi kuwe.
Kata Satan sanda, kayudo temruok;
Wach mojiwo chunya e ma;
Kristo oseng`eyo yomna duto te,
Ne otho ni mond` ores chunya.
Amor koro nikech richona duto ogur, e msalaba mare;
Noting`o kwet duto, oresa chutho;
Adendo nying Yesu ma Jawar.
Ruoth Yesu, ru ndalono mar bironi,
Ma wanawinj dwond tung` machien kaneni kibiro e boche polo
Anabedi gi kuwe e chunya.
chorus: Anyalo, bet gi kuwe;
Anyalo, bet gi kuwe e chunya.

title: Kwawuotho Gi Ruodhwa
stanzas: Kwawuotho gi Ruodhwa, kuom ler manie wachne,
Morienyna e yorwa pile ka;
Ka watimo tichne, Enobedi kodwa, bende gi ji duto.
Ka wachandore ka, ka waneno malit,
Wach Nyasaye nyalo boyo chunywa;
Ok wanyal chwanyore, ok wanyal chandore,
To Ruoth Yesu ong`eyo duto.
Koro ok wanaluor ka wabedo kode,
Ka Ruoth Yesu owuotho kodwa;
Wanang`e herane ka wachiworene,
Eka wanamor kuome pile.
Ka wahere kama, ka wawinjo chikne,
Wanadhi ku moorowae;
Kik wapar rem moro, Yesu oritowa,
Wan to mondo wagene kende.
Chieng` ka Yesu biro, eka wananene,
Bende wanamor gi Jawarwa;
Kuyo ok wanane, kata chandruok moro,
Wanadag kode e dalane.
chorus: Yie nying Yesu, Bende lu e yore;
Mondo wayud mor kuome onego wawinje.

title: An Ayie Ruoth Yesu Kende
stanzas: An ayie Ruoth Yesu kende, Asewinjo wach mare;
Onge gi manyalo loyo Ng`ato mogeno Yesu.
Kethna duto awe kuome, En oluoka gi rembe;
Enorita nyaka ndalo Ka notera ka Nyasaye.
Koro ok aluor gimoro, Chunya ogeno Yesu;
Kata yora timo mudho, Yesu ni lerna pile.
Chunya asemiyo Yesu, Ringra bende amiye;
Yesu, Jahera, Osiepna, Nobed koda nyaka chieng`.
chorus: Yesu Yesu, Yesu kaka agene!
Aseteme mang`eye;
Yesu, Yesu, medna teko,
Mond` ageni moloyo.

title: Yesu Kristo En Osiepwa
stanzas: Yesu Kristo En Osiepwa, En mogolo richowa;
Wan wanyalo kwaye pile gi maber mwachando ka;
To nikech wahero saye, ok walame pile ka,
Kuve oonge e i chunywa, eka wan wachandore.
Ka Satani dwaro temwa, ka masira makowa,
Chunywa kik oa kuom Yesu, ber kwanyiso Yesu wach;
Ere ng`ato ma dikonywa kuom masira manie piny?
Yesu emong`eyo nyawowa, ber kwanyiso Yesu wach.
Wan wanyap, wajony to pile, richowa ohingowa;
Lwandawa en Yesu Kristo, ber kwanyiso Yesu wach;
Ka osiepewa ke kodwa, ber kwanyiso Yesu wach;
Enoruakwa, enokonywa, enomiwa chuny mamor.

title: Ruoth, Ok Akwayoi Tinde
stanzas: Ruoth, ok akwayoi tinde weche mag kiny;
Rita kuom richo duto te tinendeni;
Dhoga kik opus wach moro Ma ok long`o;
In mond` ibed Jarit dhoga tinendeni.
Adwaro tiyoni matek kachiel galam;
Konya abed mang`won e wach, gi tim bende;
Miya teko mar winjoi, atim chikno;
Konya kik atim dwarona tinendeni.
To kata ngimana dirum kwauononi;
Mondo yuda kapadora kuom singruokni;
Mit kata ok akwayoi weche mag kiny,
Rita, taya, imaka, Ruoth, tinendeni.

title: Ruoth En E Jakwadha
stanzas: Ruoth En E Jakwadha, orita maber;
Lum mang`ich omiya, oruaka e kunde;
Oteloni chunya kar pige mokuwe;
Oduoga kabayo, ohoyo chuny mang`ich.
Kayudo masira kata tho malich,
Nikech In mirita, Ok naluor gimoro;
Igeng`a gi ludhi kod odungani;
Gima rach ok nyala ka Jakony ni buta.
Ipedhona mesa ndalo mar chandruok;
Imiya gweth mang`eny ma onge kar giko;
Iolona mo mang`we ng`ar e wiya;
Ng`wononi mogundho omako dhoga chuth.
Ng`wononi gi berni, Nyasacha maber;
Mondo luwre koda nyak` achop iri ku;
Nalu yorno ma jo machon noluwo,
Nyak` adonji kanyo, pinyruodhi mar hera.

title: Tim Kinda Mar Lemo
stanzas: Tim kinda mar lemo, kiwuoyo kod Ruoth;
Pidh chunyi gi wachne, kibedo kuome;
Lalri gi jokristo, kony jogo manyap;
To wiyi kik wil ngang` mar dwaro gwethne.
Tim kinda mar lemo, piny kadho piyo;
Ket kinde mar bedo apanda kod Ruoth;
Ting` wang`i kuom Yesu, ilu e ndache,
Mi timni nonyis ji kichalo kode.
Tim kinda mar lemo, Ruoth oteloni;
Kik iring e nyime, to kik idong` chien;
E mor kata chandruok, lu Yesu pile;
Chom wang`i kuom Yesu, kigeno wachne.
Tim kinda mar lemo, chunyi okuwe mos;
Yie Yesu chik chunyi kuom paro maler;
To Roho notelni kuom hera mare,
Noiki ni tichne e polo malo.

title: Winj Weche Ma Yesu Nowacho
stanzas: Winj weche ma Yesu nowacho,
Weche madier, mag ngima winjiuru ji duto,
mondo upargi;
"Gin johawi momako chikna."
Winjo nono onge gi konyruok;
Mit singruokne bedo kayiem;
winjogi, luorogi, ok onyal konywa;
Gin johawi momako chikne.
Jogo ma nodonji e dala, jo maler, maonge richo,
Jo mowar, mopwodhi, e remb Nyarombo,
Ginichopi e yath mar ngima.
chorus: Gin johawi momako chik duto, gin johawi;
Gin johawi momako chik duto;
Hawi, hawi, gin johawi.

title: Wuothi E Ler Mar Ruoth Nyasaye
stanzas: Wuothi e ler mar Ruoth Nyasaye, mamenyo wang`yori;
Muche maler, moa malo, nyalo riembo mudho.
Wuothi e ler mar puonj Ruodhwa, moa kuom Wach Nyasaye;
Ler matelo ni nyithindo, moyie Weche Nyasaye.
Wuothi kata mudho olil modino wang`yori;
Mudho noringi e nyim ler, mar Ruoth ma nyaka chieng`.
Wuothi e ler eka ning`e kaka Ruoth oheri;
Wanabed gi winjruok maduong`, moloyo mar piny ka.
chorus: Wuo...thi e ler...(wuothi e ler, wuoth e ler maber mar Nyasaye).
Wuo...thi e ler...
Wuo..thi e ler, wuothi e lerno mar Nyasaye.

title: Ka Yesu Ni Koda
stanzas: Ka Yesu ni koda, ee, anyalo dhi
Kata ka manade piny ma mwalo ni;
To ka Yesu onge morna orumo;
Ka Yesu ni koda ok anyalo luor.
Ka Yesu ni koda ok naluor chandruok;
Kata tem mang`eny olworo wang`yora;
En owuon noteme mondo okonya;
Ka Yesu ni koda anyalo loyo.
Ka Yesu ni koda ok an kenda ngang`;
Kat` osiepe weya to En Osiepna;
To kata otera e yore malich,
Ka Yesu ni koda to nabed mamor.
Ka Yesu ni koda anawinj luongne;
Kat` ochika mond` adhi e pinje mwa,
Mond` apuonj jopiny warruok man kuom rembe;
Ku mochiko anadhi ka wan kode.
Ka Yesu ni koda anyalo nindo;
Mak aluor mudho mar tho molwora ka;
Kang`eyo ni anachiew e giko piny,
Ka manade kod Yesu ni ka maber.
chorus: Ka Yesu ni koda luoro ongena;
Ka Yesu ni koda ok anyalo luor.

title: Yesu En Osiep Maber Chutho
stanzas: Yesu En Osiep maber chutho, ka parruok mar piny hewo chunyi;
Enochangi chuny motuo, nochiw teko gi ng`wono,
Ee, Yesu En Osiep maber ngang`.
Yesu En Osiepna moloyo; Omiya kuwe gi mor e chunya;
An kapadora kuome, ok aluor gimoro ngang`,
Ee, Yesu En Osiep maber ngang`.
Kata kuyo malit oyuda, kata kachopo e saa thona,
kibaji ok nogoya, nikech Jawar En koda,
Ee, Yesu En Osiep maber ngang`.
Ka wachokre e thurwa malo, Kachiel gi jogo ma notho chon,
Wanawer mamit kucha, kwadende ma nyaka chieng`,
Yesu En Osiep maber moloyo.
chorus: Yesu En Osiep maber ngang`,
(Yesu En Osiep, En Osiep maber ngang`,)
Yesu En Osiep maber ngang`;
Enokonyi kipodho, enowinji kiluongo ngang`,
Ee, Yesu En Osiep maber ngang`.

title: Owadwa Kik Iluor
stanzas: Owadwa kik iluor, Bedi gi chir pile;
Nyasaye none masicheni, Ong`eyo hoyoi.
Kata ka chunyi lit, Ka gigi kethore;
Kik chunyi ol, kik chunyi a, Nyasaye nomii kuwe.
Otieno to norum, Chieng` mar dimbruok nobi;
Masicheni duto nolal Ka Ruoth ofwenyore.
Gen hera mar Ruodhi, Onge motamo En;
Bedi pile e luetene, Noriti nyaka chieng`.

title: Yesu Ni Jakwadha
stanzas: Yesu ni Jakwadhwa, to wan rombege;
En kowuotho kodwa wanaluor ang`o?
Mondo walu bang`e ka motelonwa;
Oritowa pile, to oherwa.
Yesu ni Jakwadha, wang`eyo dwonde;
En kowuoyo kodwa koro chunywa mor;
Kata ka waketho, nowe kethruokwa;
En kende Jakonywa, to wan nyithinde.
Yesu ni Jakwadha, rembe nochwernwa;
Mond` oluokwa chutho e kethruok duto;
Oketo ranyisi kuom nyithinde te;
Mago joge duto man gi Much Nyasaye.
Yesu ni Jakwadha, bende Jageng`wa;
E temruokwa duto wanalo Satan;
Ka wagene pile nyaka chieng` watho,
Chieng` ka Yesu duogo eka wanachier.

title: Ruoth Yesu, Saa Mar Lamoi
stanzas: Ruoth Yesu, saa mar lamoi, Masuda machiegni kodi,
Mamiya paro duong` mar Ruoth, Kahulo dwarona duto;
Kar chandruok, kasudo iri, Chunya gi ringra yudo kuwe;
Kaloyo tem mar Satani; Ruoth, jiwa kuom saa mar lami.
Ruoth Yesu, saa mar lamoi, Pile ayudo mor gi kuwe;
Jogo bende ma chunygi ng`aw Yudo teko kuom lamoi;
Pile kachandora malit, Aringo ir Ruoth Jawarna;
Kuome ayudo mor maduong`, Kojiwa kuom saa mar lemo.
Ruoth Yesu, saa mar lamoi, Saano mar neni gi chunya,
Ka chunya pong` gadierani Inigwedha kuom kwayona;
Adwaro neni wang` gi wang`, Kayie wachni gi ng`wononi;
Yesu Ruodha, rita pile, Kijiwa kuom lami pile.

title: Saa Mar Lemo Mogwedhi
stanzas: Saa mar lemo mogwedhi, ka chunywa kulore,
E nyim Yesu Jawarwa bende Osiepwa;
Kwachopo ire kuom yie, ka wageno ritne;
Wanayud yueyo kanyo, wanayud kuwe mar chuny.
Saa mar lemo mogwedhi, ma Jawar sudonwa;
Chunye ng`won bende oyie winjo nyithinde;
Parruok machando chunywa, waweuru kuome;
Wanayud yueyo kanyo, wanayud kuwe mar chuny.
Saa mar lemo mogwedhi, kwasudo nyim Jawar;
Jo ma temruok oloyo noyud kuwe mar chuny;
En gi chuny makecho ngang` wanyise masichwa;
wayud yueyo kanyo, wanayud kuwe mar chuny.
Kar saa nogo mar lemo, wagene kendo yie
Kaka gweth ma wakwayo wayudo adier;
Kwageno Ruodhwa adier, wanawe parruok te;
Wanayud yueyo kanyo, wanayud kuwe mar chuny.
chorus: Saa maber mar gweth, saano mar lemo;
Wanayud yueyo kanyo, kik yudwa kwaonge.

title: Analu Bang'i Jakonya
stanzas: Analu bang`i, Jakonya, Ka midwaro telona;
Ku midhiye analuwi, Adwaro luwo bang`i.
Kata yo otimo thuche, Kata kudho chwowoa,
Isedhiyo yorno nyima, Adwaro luwo bang`i.
Kata abedo gi chandruok, Kata Satan temoa;
Kahingo notemi bende, Adwaro luwo bang`i.
Kata ayudo masira, Kabedo ng`a ma jachan,
Ing`eyo chandruok me piny ka; Adwaro luwo bang`i.
Ka di po malit oyuda, Kendo ngimana rumo
Mano gi ming`eyo duto, Adwaro luwo bang`i.
chorus: Analu bang`i, Jakonya, Isetho wi yath ni an;
Kata ji mamagi chayi, Adwaro luwo bang`i.

title: Weruru Weche Mag Nyasaye
stanzas: Weruru weche mag Nyasaye, weche mamit mag ngima;
Som giuru pile pile, weche mamit maber.
To gipuonjowa niya, ni mondo wagen Yesu.
Yesu miyo ji duto te, weche mamit mag ngima.
Ji moketho winjuruwa, weche mamit maber,
Yesu miyogi nono, ji mondo yiegi kenda
To kik wamung` ni ji me piny, weche mamit mag ngima;
To gin weche makonyogi, weche mamit maber.
Yesu Ruoth ma Jawarji, nopwodh chunygi gi wachne.
chorus: Weche mamit miwinjogi, weche mamit mag ngima.
weche mamit miwinjogi, weche mamit maber.

title: To Kak Abet Yesu Kawa
stanzas: To kak abet yesu kawa, Inyisa yo maber chutho;
Abironi, iwachona, Ruodhwa Yesu, abironi.
To kak` abet Yesu yiea, Adwaro mond iluok chunya;
To in iwe kethruok maga Ruodhwa Yesu, abironi.
To kak` abet Yesu kawa, Imiyo chunya mor pile;
Ndalo duto chunya bayo, Ruodhwa Yesu, abironi.
To kak` abet ni an muofu, an ng`a modhier morem teko;
In kende In Jakinda ngang`, Ruodhwa Yesu, abironi.
To kak` abet Yesu kawa, Iruaka, luoka, guda ka;
Nikech ageno singruokni, Ruodhwa Yesu, abironi.
To kak` abet,herani, Ruoth, Oseyawna wang`yo maler;
Mondo abed ng`ati chutho, Ruodhwa Yesu, abironi.

title: Awinjo Dwondi Maler
stanzas: Awinjo dwondi maber Moluonga iri, Ruoth;
Mond` iluok chunya gi rembi, Ma nochwer Kalwari.
An arach moloyo ji, Aonge gi teko;
Adwaro mond` iluoka chuth, Mond` abedi mapoth.
Yesu, In kibet koda, Koro natim maber;
Satani ok anonyal loya, Kabedo nyathini.
Ka pod an ie piny ka, Adwaro puonjo ji;
Kuom remb Yesu manochwernigi, E yath mar Kalwari.
Yesu In kiwir` e piny, Mondo iom jogi;
Wanadhi kodi e polo, E dalani maler.
Wan wabiro, ruoth, Wabiro tinde;
Bedi kodwa nyaka chieng` Kibiro omomwa.
chorus: An abiro, Ruoth, Abiro tinde;
Mond` iluoka gi rembi, Ma nochwer Kalwari.

title: An Ni Mari Ruoth
stanzas: An ni mari, Ruoth, to niluongoa;
Isenyisa herani;
To adwaro in mond` ibed koda,
Mond` ibed koda pile.
Adwaro mondo ati tichni, Ruoth;
Adwaro mond` ikonya;
Mondo apari ndalo duto te,
kik agomb mokome piny.
An amor pile ka atiyoni,
Ka chunya oheroi;
Ka Alamo in, ka iwinjoa,
Ka abedo nyathini.
Herani matut ok anyal ng`eyo,
Nyaka atundi kuno;
Mor man e polo okadho ng`eyo;
Nyaka ayud kuwe kuomi.
chorus: Bedi (mana) buta pile pile, Ruoth,
Ni mondo apar thoni;
Bedi mana buta pile pile, Ruoth,
Ni mond` adok nyathini.

title: Kaw Piny Duto Miya Yesu
stanzas: Kaw piny duto; miya Yesu;
Mor mar piny to mana nono;
Hera Yesu ok olokre, To osiko nyaka chieng`.
Kaw piny duto; miya Yesu;
En jahoch chutho mar chuny;
Ka Jawarna e marita, Nawer kata kuom chandruok.
Kaw piny duto miya Yesu, Mond` ang`i wang`e mamor;
Ndalo duto kuom wuodha ka Enomenyna wang`yora.
Kaw piny duto; miya Yesu;
Ageno msalabane;
Eka chieng` ka Ruodhwa biro, Ananene wang` gi wang`.
chorus: Nguonone en gi miwuoro; Herane oduong` chutho;
Warruokne, warruok madieri, Osingo ngima mak rum.

title: Kaw Ngimana
stanzas: Kaw ngimana, mond` abed mari chutho, Yesu Ruoth.
Kaw ndalona duto te; gibedi ka wer mamit.
Kaw luetena, giniti ma herani puonjoa;
Kaw tienda, mi ginidhi ka ma Ruoth chikoa.
Kendo dwonda, mond` awer pile, kende ni Ruodha;
Kendo dhoga, kawe be, analand wachni pile.
Kendo fedha, kata nok, kawgi, ok agomb moro.
Kaw riekona, ti kode gi ma idwaro Iwuon.
Kaw parona; kik adwar gi ma ok idwaro In.
Kendo chunya, en mari, dak kanyo e chunya, Ruoth.
Kaw herana, Yesu Ruoth; an amiyi duto te.
Kaw chutho, mond` abed pile, kende, mari Ruoth.
chorus: Luoka e remo mar Jawarna, (mar Jawarna);
Pwodha chutho gi rembe maler; (rembe maler);
Ruoth, achiwrani gi ngimnana duto,
Abed mari nyaka chieng`.

title: Bedi Mangima Kuoma
stanzas: Bedi mangima kuoma, Ruoth Yesu Jawarna;
Ka wach ochando chunya, inyisa wach maber;
Bedi mangima kuoma, chika e wang`yori;
An mond` abed ka taya manyiso ler mari.
Asechiwoni chunya, gi ngimana duto,
Isepuodha kuom kethna, mondo arieny ni ji;
Ringra obed kar dakni, hekalu maler;
Timna gi wuodha duto, obed gi michiko.
Fuondega duto magi, In mond` iti kodgi;
Abed gir tichni chutho; kik atim dwarona;
Ruoth Yesu taya pile, kinyisa herani;
Weche piny ok nyal chanda ka In idak koda.
Kuve mari opong` chunya, abed mos kageni;
Arito mond` inyisa gi monego atim;
Bedi mangima kuoma, Ibed Ruoth e chunya;
To chieng` mibiro, Ruodha, naneni wang` gi wang`

title: Ywaya Machiegni Buti Ruodha
stanzas: Ywaya machiegni buti, Ruodha;
Agombo bet kodi Ywaya,
Ruaka gi hera mari, Adwaro kar yueyo.
Ywaya machiegni, Jawar, ywaya,
Kik iweya kenda;
Nabed mamor kabedo buti, kachandruok orumo.
Ywaya gi roho mari, ywaya,
Nyaka achal kodi;
Luoka, pwodha, kimiya bedo Maler kak` idwaro.
chorus: Ywaya (ywaya) iri gi herani;
Ywaya (ywaya) iri e polo;
Ywaya, ywaya; (Ywaya iri gi hera, ywaya iri malo ku;)
Iri malo ku. (Ywaya iri malo ku.)

title: Diyie Dak Kod Yesu
stanzas: Diyie dak kod Yesu, mond` ibed maler pile?
Diyie wuoth kode e yo madiny koso?
Diyie mond` okaw ting`ni duto koting`oni?
Yiene ni mond` otelni.
Diyie mond` ogonyi kendo iwinj wach mare
Donge ing`eyo kuwe ma chiwruok kelo?
Ok diher mond` owari, kik ipodhi e keth?
Yiene ni mond` otelni.
Diher yud kar bet e pinyruodhe malo koso?
Diher ng`eyo tekone mar loyo tem?
Idwaro tiyo ni Ruoth gi tekoni duto?
Yiene ni mond` otelni.
chorus: Tekone nyalo losi makare, Rembe nyalo luoko chunyi maler;
Hera mare nyalo mi chunyi mor;
Diber kiyie mondo Ruoth otelni.

title: Aseweyo Tich Maricho
stanzas: Aseweyo tich maricho, Ni mondo alu Yesu;
En ma yandi ji nochaye, Osedoko ngimana.
Ok ageno teko moro, Ok ageno pith mar piny;
Pith adieri ni e chunya; Ruoth mar polo ni Ruodha.
Kata ji duto oriemba, Ji duto noweyo En;
Chuny marach owuondo pile, En kende e mageno.
Ka da herane bet koda, kuyo ok donyal maka,
Ok danwang` mor e piny kae, Ka da onge herano.
Yesu kende e moroma, Muche mond` orit chunya;
Eka tichne anamaki, Enopuonja kindane.
Pinywani otimo mudho; Chieng` mudho nolal chutho,
Konya! mond` achungi chieng`no E pinyruodhi mosiko.

title: Awaro Bedo Nyathi Yesu
stanzas: Adwaro bedo nyathi Yesu; Nyisa yo, nyisa yo;
Datim chikni duto, Jawarna, Konya tinende.
Pith gi duong` mar piny odok nono, Mak Intie, mak Intie;
Anawe giduto ni Nyingi, Mwanduna ni ma.
Kawito gik mantie e piny ka, Sud buta, sud buta;
Gik masiko duto ni kodi, Ma okonya ka.
chorus: Mari chuth (Ruodhwa), Mari chuth (Ruodhwa),
Mari chutho asingo;
Mari chuth (Ruodhwa),Mari chuth (Ruodhwa),
Mari chutho koroni.

title: Teko Nyasaye Orita
stanzas: Teko Nyasaye orita, Abed ng`at Yesu chuth;
Abed maler e pinyni kaluwo ndach Yesu.
Teko Nyasaye orita, Atim gi modwaro;
Abed ng`ate malong`o, Moikre ni tich Ruoth.
Teko Nyasaye orita, Apogra chuth kod piny;
Abed gi chuny mar Yesu-mamuol, mang`won, maler.
Teko Nyasaye orita, Abed ng`ate kende;
Abed ng`at Yesu koro, Kendo ma nyaka chieng`.
chorus: Teko Nyasaye orita; Ruoth, apodho nyimi;
Ok an gimoro chutho, chutho, In ngimana duto.

title: Asebayo Mabor Kodi
stanzas: Asebayo mabor kodi Ruodha, koro abironi,
Adwaro mondo abed e ritni, koro abironi.
Aol gi piny kod richo mogundho kor` adwogo dala;
Ayie Jawar norwaka e kunde kor` aduogo dala.
Ang`eyo Jawar nomiya yweyo kor` adwogo dala;
Adwaro keto chunya e lwete kor` aduogo dala.
Ayie tiyoni ka ng`ama jachan kor` adwogo dala;
Adwaro nwang`o ng`wono mar Jawar kor` adwogo dala.
Pakuru Ruoth, aneno Jawarna kor` adwogo dala;
Orito rwako jomolal ka an kor` adwogo dala.
chorus: Koro adwogo Ruoth ee adwogo, Ruoth adwogo dala;
Koro adwogo, Ruoth ee adwogo, Ruoth adwogo dala.

title: Isedwaro Yueyo Kod Yie Momedore
stanzas: Isedwaro yuweyo kod yie momedore, Isesayo gi chuny motur ngang`; Yuweyo ok niyud ngang` kata gweth malong`o, Nyak isechiwori misango.
Ber iwuoth gi Ruodhi e ler manie wachne,To niyuwe e yo maber mar Ruoth,Nyak itim chik Ruodhi mond` ibed maler chuth,Gigi te nyak` ichiw misango.
Ok wanyal ng`eyo ngang` Gik ma Ruoth chiwonwa,Kuom gwethgo ma wasekwayogo,Ringrewa kod chunywa, Oneg ochik chutho, Kendo wachiw duto misango.
Ng`a ma diwach hera mobiro oronwa,Kendo chunywa nobed mamor ngang`;Mit mar wuoyo kode noromwa waduto, Kwasechiwo duto misango.
chorus: Iseketo gigi te e kar Misango? Bende Roho maler teloni? Inyalo yudo gweth mibedi gi kuwe chuth;Ka ichiwone chunyi duto.

title: Mana Kak' Abet Abironi
stanzas: Mana kak` abet abiro, ok anyal bet maber kenda,Adwaro rembi moroma yie iwara kuom ng`wononi.
Mana kak` abet ang`eyo, Rembi kende emoroma,Noluoka matar moloyo komiya genoi chutho.
Mana kak` abet abiro,chunya mool ogomboi,Ok anyal bet mabor kodi, Adwaro bet mari chutho.
Chunya gi ngimana duto, Mondo oyud yuweyo kuomi K`ase bayo ma ase ol, Ayuweyo kuom hera mari.
chorus: Kaka abet, kaka abet abironi,O Ruoth winja, gwedha, wara ,kaka abet abironi.

title: Wuora ,Atang'oni Lueta
stanzas: Wuora, atang`oni lueta, In kendi kar konyruok;Ka da iweya kenda ngang`, An to dachik kanye?
An koro ayie kuom Wuodi; Mond` ang`e tekoni;Imiya gik marem koro, Mondo ipong` chunya.
In Wuon genruok; ang`iyoi Kageno konyruokni;Kik idaga, asayoi, Ayud ngima kuomi.
chorus: Ayie koro, Ayie chutho, Ni Yesu nothona;Rembe nochwer ni mond` ayud Gonyruok e richona.

title: Yesu An Adwaro
stanzas: O Yesu, an adwaro Atini nyaka chieng` Asayi bedi buta, Ruodha ma jakonya.Ok analuor lwenj Satan ka In ibet buta; Yo maber ok aweyo ka In itelona.
Mondo ang`e in koda, Pinyni oywayoa;Aneno gik magombo, Dwonde matemoa; Wasika gi gilwora, Kendo gin e chunya; O Yesu, bi, ikonya, Mondo alo Satan.
O Yesu, isewacho duto molu bang`i, Ka ma intie e duong`ni Ginibedi bende.To Yesu, an adwaro Atini nyaka chieng`;Asayi konya pile, Ruodha ma Jawarna.

title: Weche Mag Mirima
stanzas: Weche mag mirima mondo Kik pusre a e dhowa;Paro maber mond` ogeng`gi Ka pok giwuok e dhowa.
Wach marach jawuok mapiyo, To gin gik maduwo chuny;Gi maketho osiep kindwa, To weche mag mirima.
Hera ler kendo olong`o, Kik wayie ketho osiep;Nikech wach marach mwapuso; Ber mondo warit dhowa.
chorus: "Heroreuru," Ruodhwa owacho;Nyithindo winjuru chik mar Wuoro;(Herreuru, herreuru, Winjuru chik mar Wuoro;), "Heroreuru," Ruodhwa owacho; Nyithindo, winjuru chikne, (Herreuru, herreuru, Winjuru chikne.)

title: Otelona
stanzas: Otelona! Amor chutho, To Yesu e motelona;Gima datim kama antie, To En Owuon otelona.
Ka chunya lit, ka chunya yom, Ka yamo nego ji e piny;Masira dak oketha ngang`! Yesu Owuon otelona.
Hapi oroma nyaka chieng`, Itieko nyisa yo maber;To kata yo obet mabor, Yesu Iwuon itelona.
Jachien odwaro wuondowa, Jopiny giweya kenda ka;To ng`at maber moloyogi, Yesu owuon otelona.
Ka tichna gik e pinywa ka, Abiro chopo e polo;Ka tho obiro ok aluor, Yesu Owuon otelona
chorus: Otelona! Otelona! Ee, En Owuon otelona, Adwaro luwe nyaka chieng`, Adier to En motelona.

title: Adwaro Bet Buti
stanzas: Adwaro bet buti, Nyasaye Wuora; Abed buti chutho, Yesu Ruodha Ndalo duto abed buti Nyasaye Wuora; Asik buti pile Nyasaye Wuora.
Achalo gi jawuoth e pinyni ka; Kar yueyo ongena, ler onge be;To adwaro siko buti Nyasaye Wuora, Asik buti pile Nyasaye Wuora.
Duto mimiyoa kuom ng`wononi, Giywayo chunya chuth, abed buti;Nyisa wang`yo mari, en e ma mond` alu; Asik buti pile, Nyasaye Wuora.
Kendo gi tekona nadend nyingi; In Lwandana, Ruodha, In warruokna;Kata e masira, apadora kuomi, Asik buti pile, Nyasaye Wuora.
Kochier a e liel ching` bironi, Adonj ka ma Intie, Nyasaye Wuora;Nayud mor mochwere e dalani maber, Nabed buti pile, ma nyaka chieng`.

title: Paro Achiel Mamit
stanzas: Paro achiel mamit, Osiko e chunya;Ndalo sudo machiegini, Ma nadonj e polo.
E dala mar Wuora, Nitie udi mang`eny;Kom-duong` Nyasaye ni kanyono, En kar bet Yesu Ruoth.
Ka tichna orumo, Masira gi kuyo;Nadonj e dala mar Wuora, Nosidhna osimbo.
chorus: Achiegini donjo thurwa; Koro achiegni donjo, Ndalo odong` matin.

title: Onego abed gi Yesu
stanzas: Onego abed gi Yesu, Ok anyal wuotho kenda. Ka Yesu obedo buta Anyalo yudo teko.
Onego abed gi Yesu, Kuom Yie mara e chunya; Wechene ohoyo chunya, Ka gimiya tekone.
Onego abed gi Yesu, E ngimana duto te;Kata an e temruok moro, kata e parruok moro.
Onego abed gi Yesu E yorena duto te;Eka an anyalo chopo E dala mosingonwa.
chorus: Eka chunya ok noluor (ok noluor); Anadhi ka modwaro, (modwaro);Anadhi mapiyo piyo, Kotelona e wang`yo.

title: Ruoth Ni Koda E Yo Duto
stanzas: Ruoth ni koda e yo duto, Ere gi marem koro? En Jatenda e piny kae, Nyaka ngimana duto; Kuwe gi hoch ayudo kuome; Awuotho kode pile; Kata gi manade yuda, Yesu norita maber, Kata gi manade yuda, Yesu norita maber.

Ruoth ni koda e yo duto, Kata yo obet marach; Nokonya e temruok duto; Nomiya chiemb chuny maler, Ka di po tienda dichwanyre, Enojuka gi luete; Ka riyo oloyo chunya, Nomia pi mar ngima; Ka riyo ohewo chunya, Nomia pi mar ngima.

Ruoth ni koda e yo duto; An awuoro herane, Mosesingona kar yueyo, Dala mar Nyasaye Wuora;Anayud ngima mochwere, ka wuodha me piny rumo;"Ruoth notelna e yo duto," Nobed wenda nyaka chieng`"Ruoth notelna e yo duto," Nobed wenda nyaka chieng.

title: Telna O yaye Ruoth Jehova
stanzas: Telna O yaye Ruoth Jehova, Kuom wuodha e piny marach;An anyap to in gi teko Juka gi lueti matekKuon mar polo Kuon mar polo, Pidha nyaka yieng` chutho (yieng` chutho).
Yaw koro soko mar lerni Kama pi ngima wuokie;Ket bor Polo maber mogwedhi Telna e wuodha duto;Ruoth molocho Ruoth molocho, Bed teko g`okumba (gokumba).
Ka wuotho e geng aoch Jordan Mi mondo luocha olal;Ruodh ruodhi makelo ngima Kel ngima loka Kanaan;Wende ma paki Wende ma paki, Ana wer nigi pile (wer pile).

title: Yesu kotaya pile
stanzas: Yesu kotaya pile, Oritowa mang`uon;An to kabedo bute, Onge gi manyalo luor.Winji, machalo dwonde Malaika mawero, Weche mabiro ira, Weche mamiya mor.
Yesu kotaya pile, Ok anaparora; Piny ok onyalo teroa, Kata richo kethoa;Kata aparo ndalo Ok analuor gimoro;Kata ane masira, Chieng` anamor kucha.
An anadhi ka Yesu, En ma notho kuoma;Pile ageno Yesu, Lwandana mogeng`ona;Piny pod otimo mudho Ka pod awuotho kae; Piny to norum mapiyo, Eka nadhi kucha.
chorus: Yesu kotaya pile, Oritoa mang`won;An to kabedo bute, Onge gi manyalo luor.

title: Be Yesu ling
stanzas: Be Yesu ling` ka chunya otur, Kuom dwaro mor kata wer;Saa ma ting` tura parruok be ola, ka wuoth bedo maolo chuny?
Be Yesu ling` ka chunya opong` kod buok be luoro mathoth;Kodiechieng` rumo kotieno chopo, bende obedo machiegni?
Be Yesu ling` saa ma tem matek asekedogo motama;Ka chunya kuyo hoch be ongena, kata pi wang`a chwer malit?
Be Yesu ling` ka tho pogoa gosiepna mahero chuth;Ka chunya kuyo kachiegni gi tho, be oling` ma ok onena?
chorus: Ee, orita mano adier; Kuyona mulo chunye;Ka aol godiechieng`, Kaluor gotieno, adier Jawar rita (adier).

title: Ka Yembe Mag Kuyo Luora
stanzas: Ka yembe mag kuyo luora, gipandona yo mar ngima;Chunya ok nobed gi luoro, ang`eyo ng`a matayoa.
Pile kat` apaka tuoma, kaneno luendni mag chandruok;Luoro kod kiawa ongena, ang`eyo ng`a matayoa.
Kata tem birona pile, kata nam bed marach nade;To nyaka anagow loka, Ang`eyo ng`a matayoa.
Hera Jawar pod telona, En e monyisa yo maber;Nagene nyaka atiek wuodha, Ang`eyo ng`a matayoa.
chorus: Ee, ang`eyo ng`a mataya kang`ado namno mar chandruok.(Ee, ang`eyo ng`a mataya kang`ado namno mopong` gi chandruok chutho).Yembe kudho, apaka ger. Ka Yesu telo, duto ber.(Yembe kudho, apaka ger. Ka Yesu telo, duto ber, ee, duto ber).

title: Jawar Telna Kik Alal
stanzas: Jawar telna kik alal (ni kik alal), Telna mos e yo duto( e yo duto);An gi kue ka an buti (ka an buti), Dagomb bet e herani (e herani).
In e kar bwok mar chunya (kuwe mar chunya), Ka yamo maduong` kudho (Yamo kudho);An gi kuwe ka in buta (ka in buta), An gi geno kuomi Ruoth (geno kuomi).
Jawar telna pile ka (telna pile), Ka yamo osekadho (yamo kadho);Telna nyaka piny manyien (Ruodha telna), Kama piwang`wa noywe (Wang`wa noywe).
chorus: Telna, Telna, Jawar telna kik alal (kik alal),Telna ndalo dutote (duto te), Jawar telna yo duto (yo duto).

title: Ka Chandruok Mar Piny Ochopo
stanzas: Ka chandruok mar piny ochopo, Lweny mager e piny gi nam,Anadwar kar pondo mara, e bwo tipo lwet Nyasaye.
Kata da okelna chandruok, pod named geno polo,Ruoth okumo jomohero, konyisogi yo maber.
Ka wasika dwaro hinya, Ka Satan dwaro loya,Ruoth nolok gima dihinya, Obedna mor mochwere.
Ka ating`o msalapa, Ka aneno chandruok e piny,Yesu e ma rito chunya, ok noweya mond` alal.
chorus: Enopa....na, Enopa....na, Kama chandruok ok noyuda, Enopa.....na, Enopa....na. E bwo tipo luet Nyasaye.

title: Kwonde Duto Motelona
stanzas: Kwonde duto motelona, Anadhi nikech agene; Aparo kaka nothona, Rembe nochwer e Kalwari.
An amor kawinjo chikne; Amor chutho kotelona;To chunya mor kuom dwarone, Kaparo thone Kalwari.
Adhiyo nyime mak aluor, Amor kuom Kristo, Jawarna;Ageno neno Osiepna, Yesu mothona Kalwari.
chorus: Yesu notelna pile ka, Yesu notelna yo duto; En e Osiep mageno chuth; En nothona e Kalwari.

title: In Wang Yorwa
stanzas: In wang`yorwa; wabironi Kwaringo keth gi tho;Kendo ng`a modwaro wuoro Nyak` odware kuomi.
In Adiera; Wachni kende Nyalo miwa rieko;Puonj madieri oa kuomi, In ma Japwodh chunywa.
In ngimawa; liel ma notur Ohulo tekoni;Tho kata liel ok anonyal Jogo magenoi.
In yo, Adiera, gi Ngima; Puonjwa wang`e yorno;Konywa warit adierano, Miwa ngimani, Ruoth.

title: Yesu Onindo E Jasi
stanzas: Yesu onindo e jasi, Kokadho nam Galili; Ahiti maduong` to okudho, Pi nam gingore malich.Jopuonjre chiewe gi luoro; `Ruoth ok idew kwatho?` Eka Yesu nokwero apaka, Nochiko yembe giling`.
Yesu achandora tinde, Apaka ni e chunya;Temruok to obiro ka yamo, Ayiengini, Ruoth konya.Kethruok awinjo kohewa, Chunya odhier chutho,To Ruoth Yesu bi piyo, asayi; Bi sira gi tekoni.

Ruodha, chunya koro kuwe mos, Chandruok osekadhona;Kuwe mari koro ni e chunya, Kuom teko mar wachni, Ruoth.Bed koda pile, Jawarna, Kik iweya kenda ngang`;Eka danyal chopo ka maner cha, Abed kodi nyaka chieng`.
chorus: To yembe gapaka winjo wach Ruoth: `Kuweuru, kuweuru!` Kata apaka mar nam lolwe Makelo kibaji gi ngoro ni ji,To onge gimoro manyalo nimo Yieno, ka ma Ruoth polo nindoe;Gik moko duto nowinj chikne: `Kuweuru, kuweuru!`Gik moko duto nowinj chikne: `Mondo ukuwe!`

title: Yesu Obiro Ka Kendo
stanzas: Yesu obiro ka kendo, Yesu ma notho Kalwari; Obiro omo jo moyie, Mondo gidhi polo.
Waneno tim mang`eny e piny Mapuonjowa wach birone;Chieng`no obiro mana ru Ma wanadhi polo.
Ndalo mang`eny to lweny nitie; To pinje ok noyudi kuwe;Nyaka Jawarwa wir` e piny, Mond` oterwa polo.
Eka e piny maber, manyien, Wanabedi ma nyaka chieng`;Ok wanachak waketh kendo, To wanamor pile.
chorus: Obiro, obiro, Birone koro ochiegini; Ee, obiro; ee, obiro; obiro machiegini.

title: Wuoth Pod Odong Marom Nade?
stanzas: Wuoth pod odong` marom nade? Jarit odwoko wach kama; `Otieno chiegini rumo, Piny biro mana ru.` Kik koro ibed gi kuyo, Iteg wang`i ku midhiye, Nyak` idonje pinyruodh Nyasaye, Kar ler ma nyaka chieng`.
Napenjo kendo jakedo; Nomiya wach mahoyo chuny;`Kedi matek, ibed jachir, Ndalo odong` matin.`Kik koro ibed gi kuyo, Tim kinda nyaka tich rumo;Wabiro yudo pok maber Kwaseyudo locho.
Napenjo kendo kak` obet; Piny ngima nodwoka kama;"Wuoth me pinyni dwaro rumo, Waki ma nyaka chieng` " Kik koro wabed gikuyo, Ranyisi ng`eny mayangonwa,Ni chwech duto rito winjo Dwond Ruodhwa kobiro.
Ok bor koro nyaka thurwa! Wachni hoyo chunywa e yo;Ogolo kuyo gi pi wang`, Omiyo chunywa kuwe.Kik koro wabed gi kuyo, Podi matin to wanarom,E kar mor chutho mochwere, E dala mar Wuonwa.

title: Gin Weche Mamit
stanzas: Gin weche mamit ma Jakristo owinjo, Kowuotho e piny marachni;Ndalo dong` matin nyaka Ruoth Yesu nobi, Kobiro chungo pinyruodhe.
Liete ka ma koro Jokristo nindoe, Noyawre malach e chieng`no;Ji duto maler ma notho kageno Ruoth, Nochier gi ngima mochwere.
Pogruok ok nobedi kucha e piny manyien, Ji nodag kuro nyaka chieng`;Mowar a tung` piny duto nobedi kuro, Ka gipako Ruoth gi wende.
Wawer "Alleluya" kwadendo Ruoth Yesu; Wabed jo madieri chutho;Kwarito gi kinda nyaka Ruodhwa nobi, Nosidhnwa osimbo maber.
chorus: Obiro, birone ochiegini; Obiro e pinyni kendo;Eka noom jogo duto mohere, Ginidhi kode e polo.

title: Jo Maler Duto Rituru
stanzas: Jo maler duto rituru teko polo koro, Yiengni;Mokuru techeu duto, kurito biro mar ruodhwa.
Landuru wach kwonde duto,Kunyiso ji wach mar warruok;Kuom jathieth gi hera mare, kod teko mar weyo richo.
Pinje Ruodhi biro kadho; Pinyruodhe oduong` gilala;Landuru wach nguono mare, Ka ndalogi pok okadho.
Ogend pinyni to lal nono, kamirima pong`o chunygi;Kristo dwaro biro piyo, Mondo pinyruodhe ochungi.
